verses.text:
The happinesses of the man who walks not in the advice of the wicked,
and stands not in the pathway of sinners,
and sits not in the seat of scoffers,

but in the instruction of Yahweh is his delight,
and in his instruction he meditates day and night.

And he is like a tree set to grow by streams of water,
which gives its fruit in its season,
and its leaf does not wither,
and he makes successful all that he does.

Not so the wicked!
But they are like the chaff that wind chases away.

Thus the wicked will not stand in the judgment,
nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

For Yahweh knows the way of the righteous,
but the way of the wicked will perish.

Why do nations conspire
and peoples plot futilely?

The kings of the earth take their stand,
and the rulers conspire together
against Yahweh and against his anointed.

“Let us tear apart their bonds
and cast their cords away from us.”

He who is sitting in the heavens laughs;
the Lord mocks them.

Then he will speak to them in his anger
and terrify them in his fury,

“I, I have poured out my king
on Zion, the mountain of my holiness.”

I will describe a decree of Yahweh.
He said to me, “You are my son!
Today I have begotten you.

Ask from me, and I will give nations as your inheritance
and the extremities of the earth as your possession.

You will break them with an iron rod;
like a jar of a potter, you will smash them to pieces.”

And now kings, act prudently;
be admonished, rulers of the earth.

Serve Yahweh with fear
and rejoice with trembling.

Kiss the son, lest he be angry
and you perish in the way,
for his anger burns for just a moment.
The happinesses of all the seekers of refuge in him.

verses.superscription: A psalm of David, when he fled from the face of Absalom his son
verses.text:
Yahweh, how many my oppressors have become!
The risers against me are many.

There are many sayers about me,
“There is no salvation for him in God.” Selah

But you, Yahweh, are a shield round about me,
my glory, and the lifter up of my head.

With my voice I call to Yahweh,
and he answered me from the hill of his holiness. Selah

I laid myself down and slept. I awoke,
for Yahweh protects me.

I will not fear the multitudes of people
who stand against me round about.

Salvation is of Yahweh.
Your blessing is on your people. Selah

verses.superscription: For the chief musician; with stringed instruments; a psalm of David.

verses.text:
Son of man, until when will my glory become shame?
Until when will you love futility, until when will you seek falsehood? Selah

But know that Yahweh has set apart the faithful for himself.
Yahweh hears when I call to him.

Tremble and do not sin!
Meditate in your heart on your bed and be silent. Selah

Sacrifice sacrifices of righteousness
and trust in Yahweh.

Many say, “Who will show us good?”
Lift up the light of your face on us, Yahweh!

You have put joy in my heart
more than the time when their grain and their new wine abound.

In peace I will both lie down and sleep,
for you alone, Yahweh, cause me to dwell securely.

verses.superscription: For the chief musician; on the flutes; a psalm of David
verses.text:
To my words give ear, Yahweh!
Understand my murmuring!

Listen attentively to the sound of my cry for help,
my king and my God,
for to you I pray!

Yahweh, in the morning you hear my voice.
In the morning I prepare for you and watch.

For you are not a god pleased with wickedness;
evil ones will not sojourn with you.

The arrogant will not stand in front of your eyes;
you hate all doers of iniquity.

You will destroy speakers of falsehood;
the man of blood and deceit Yahweh abhors.

But I, in the greatness of your covenant faithfulness, I will come into your house;
I will bow down toward your temple of holiness in fear.

Yahweh, guide me in your righteousness because of my watchers;
straighten before my face your path.

Make them guilty, God;
may they fall due to their schemes!
Because of their many transgressions, drive them out,
for they rebel against you!

But may all refuge seekers in you rejoice;
may they shout joyfully to eternity,
and may you cover over them,
and may lovers of your name exult in you.

For you, Yahweh, you bless the righteous,
you surround him with favor as a shield.

verses.superscription: For the chief musician; with stringed instruments; on Sheminith; a psalm of David.
verses.text:
Yahweh, rebuke me not in your nose,
and in your rage discipline me not.

Be gracious to me, Yahweh, for I am frail!
Heal me, Yahweh, for my bones are shaking!

And my soul is very disturbed.
And you, Yahweh, until when?

Turn back, Yahweh! Rescue my soul!
Save me for the sake of your covenant faithfulness!

For in death, there is no remembrance of you.
In Sheol, who will thank you?

I am weary with my groaning.
During every night, I cause my bed to swim,
With my tears, my couch I melt.

My eye has wasted away from grief,
it advances because of all my adversaries.

Turn away from me, all you doers of iniquity,
for Yahweh has heard the sound of my sobbing!

Yahweh has heard my appeal for mercy,
Yahweh accepts my prayer.

Let all my enemies be shamed and greatly disturbed.
Let them turn back. Let them be shamed in an instant.

verses.superscription: A musical composition of David, which he sang to Yahweh concerning the words of Cush the Benjamite.
verses.text:
Yahweh my God, in you I have taken refuge;
save me from all my pursuers, and rescue me!

Lest he rip my life apart like a lion,
tearing apart, and there is no one to rescue.

Yahweh my God, if I have done this,
if there is wrong on my hands,

if I have repaid evil to one who was at peace with me,
or senselessly rescued my adversary,

Arise, Yahweh!
In your nose, be lifted with the rage of my adversaries!
And wake up for me!
You have ordered judgment.

And an assembly of peoples surround you,
and over it return on high!

Yahweh, adjudicate the peoples!
Judge me, Yahweh,
according to my righteousness and according to my integrity, Most High!

May the evil of the wicked end, and would you establish the righteous.
The righteous God examines hearts and kidneys.

My shield is with God,
the savior of the upright of heart.

God is a righteous judge,
and a God who is indignant on every day.

If he does not repent, his sword he will sharpen,
his bow he has bent and prepared.

And for him he has prepared implements of death;
he has made his arrows into burning arrows.

Behold he is pregnant with wickedness,
and he conceives trouble,
and he births lies.

He digs a pit and hollows it out
and falls into the hole he has made.

His trouble returns on his head,
and his violence comes down on the top of his head.

I will thank Yahweh according to his righteousness,
and sing praise to the name of Yahweh, the Most High.

verses.superscription: For the chief musician; on Gittith. A psalm of David.
verses.text:
Yahweh, our Lord, how magnificent is your name in all the earth,
you whose splendor is bestowed on the heavens.

Out of the mouth of children and nursing ones you have established strength
because of your adversaries,
to cause the enemy and avenger to end.

When I look at your heavens, the work of your fingers,
the moon and the stars, which you have set in place,

what is mankind that you remember him,
or the son of man that you pay attention to him?

Yet you have made him to lack little from the heavenly beings,
and with glory and majesty you have crowned him.

You made him rule over the works of your hands,
everything you have put under his feet:

sheep and oxen—all of them,
and also the animals of the field,

birds of the sky, and the fish of the sea,
the passers on the paths of the seas.

Yahweh, our Lord,
how magnificent is your name in all the earth!

verses.superscription: For the chief musician; on “The Death of the Son.” A psalm of David.
verses.text:
I will thank Yahweh with all my heart,
I will recount all your wonders.

I will rejoice and exult in you,
I will sing praise to your name, Most High!

When my enemies turn back,
they stumble and perish from your face.

For you have done my justice and my claim;
you have sat on your throne, a judge of righteousness!

You rebuked nations; you destroyed the wicked;
you blotted out their name forever and ever.

The enemy are finished—desolation forever,
and you pulled up cities.
As for them, their remembrance perished,

but Yahweh will sit forever.
He has established his throne for justice,

as for him, he will judge the world with righteousness,
and he will adjudicate for the peoples with fairness.

And may Yahweh be a secure height for the oppressed,
a secure height for times with distress.

And may the knowers of your name trust in you,
because you have not abandoned the seekers of you, Yahweh.

Sing praises to Yahweh, the sitter in Zion!
Declare his deeds among the peoples

for the seeker of vengeance for bloodshed remembered them;
he does not forget the cry of the poor.

Have mercy on me, Yahweh! See my affliction from my haters,
O lifter of me from the gates of death,

in order that I might recount all your praise
in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
I will rejoice in your salvation!

The nations have sunk down into the pit they made;
their foot is caught in the net that they hid.

Yahweh has revealed himself, he has done justice;
the wicked is ensnared by the work of his hands. Higgaion Selah

The wicked will turn back to Sheol;
all nations are forgetful of God.

But the needy will not be forgotten eternally,
nor will the hope of the afflicted perish forever.

Arise, Yahweh! Let not humanity prevail!
On your face let nations be judged.

Put terror to them, Yahweh!
May nations know they are human. Selah

Why, Yahweh, do you stand far-off?
Why do you hide in times of trouble?

In arrogance, the wicked hotly pursue the afflicted;
may they be caught by the schemes that they have planned.

Indeed, the wicked boasts about the desires of his soul
and he blesses the robber; he despises Yahweh.

According to the haughtiness of his nose the wicked seeks not;
All his thoughts are, “There is no God.”

He says in his heart, “I will not be shaken;
to generation and generation it is I who will not be in distress.”

His mouth is full of curses and lies and oppression;
under his tongue are mischief and evil.

He sits in ambush near the villages; in the secret places he murders the innocent;
his eyes stealthily watch for a helpless person.

He stoops, crouches,
and unfortunate people fall by his power.

He says in his heart, “God has forgotten;
he has hidden his face; to perpetuity he sees not.”

Arise, Yahweh! God, lift up your hand!
Do not forget the afflicted ones.

Why does the wicked despise God?
He says in his heart, “You will not seek.”

Break the arm of the wicked and the evil.
May it seek his wickedness, but not find it.

Yahweh is king forever and ever;
the nations have perished from his land.

The desire of afflicted ones, you have heard, Yahweh;
you strengthen their heart, you cause your ear to attend:

to judge the orphan and oppressed;
that mankind who is from the earth will never again terrify.

verses.superscription: To the chief musician; of David.
verses.text:
In Yahweh I take refuge.
How can you say to my soul,
“Flutter like a bird to your mountain.

If the foundations are destroyed,
what can the righteous do”?

Yahweh tests the righteous and the wicked,
and the one loving violence his soul hates.

May he rain snares upon the wicked;
fire and brimstone and a scorching wind the portion of their cup!

For Yahweh is righteous, he loves righteousness;
the upright will see his face.

verses.superscription: For the chief musician; on Sheminith; a psalm of David.
verses.text:
Help, Yahweh, for the faithful have come to an end;
for the faithful have vanished from among the sons of man.

May Yahweh cut off all lips of smoothness,
the tongue speaking great things,

which say, “With our tongue we will make strong.
Our lips are with us, who is master over us?”

“Because of oppression of the poor, because of the groaning of the needy,
Now I will arise,” says Yahweh.
“I will place in the safety he pants for it.”

The words of Yahweh are pure words,
silver refined in a furnace on the ground,
purified seven.

You Yahweh, you will keep them.
You will protect him from this generation for eternity.

The wicked walk about on every side
when vileness is high among the sons of man.

verses.superscription: To the chief musician; a psalm of David.
verses.text:
How long, Yahweh? Will you forget me forever?
How long will you hide your face from me?

How long must I take counsel in my soul,
sorrow in my heart by day?
How long will the one being hostile to me be high over me?

Consider and answer me, Yahweh my God;
give light to my eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death,

Lest the one being hostile to me say, “I have prevailed over him,”
and my adversaries rejoice when I am shaken.

But I have trusted in your covenant faithfulness;
let my heart rejoice in your salvation.

I will sing to Yahweh,
because he has dealt bountifully with me.

verses.superscription: For the chief musician; of David
verses.text:
The fool says in his heart, “No God.”
They are corrupt, they do a deed abominably.
There is none doing good.

Yahweh looks down from the heavens on the sons of man
to see whether there is one understanding, one seeking God.

The whole has turned aside. Together they have corrupted themselves.
There is none doing good, not even one.

Do they not know, all of the doers of iniquity,
the ones eating my people as they eat bread?
They do not call upon Yahweh.

There they feared a fear,
for God is with the generation of the righteous.

You shame the counsel of the afflicted,
but Yahweh is his refuge.

Who will give the salvation of Israel from Zion?
When Yahweh restores the prosperity of his people,
Jacob will be glad, Israel will rejoice.

verses.superscription: A psalm of David
verses.text:
Yahweh, who may sojourn in your tent?
Who may dwell on your holy mountain?

The one walking blamelessly,
and doing righteousness
and speaking truth in his heart.

He does not slander with his tongue,
he does not do evil to his neighbor,
and an insult he does not raise up against one close to him.

In whose eyes one being rejected is despised,
but those who fear Yahweh he honors.
He swears to his own hurt, and does not change.

He does not put out his money at interest,
and a bribe against the innocent he does not take.
The one doing these things will not be shaken for eternity.

verses.superscription: A miktam of David.
verses.text: Protect me, God, for I take refuge in you.
You said to Yahweh, “You are my Lord; my good is not beyond you.”
As for the holy ones who are on the earth, they are the majestic ones; all my delight is in them.

Their sorrows will be multiplied, they who hasten after another god. I will not pour out their drink offerings from blood,
and I will not take up their names on my lips.
Yahweh, the portion of my inheritance and my cup. You are holding my lot.
The measuring cords have fallen for me in pleasant places; indeed, the inheritance is beautiful for me.
I will bless Yahweh, who has given me counsel; even in the night my kidneys instruct me.
I have set Yahweh continually before me, because he is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoices. Also, my flesh will dwell in security.
For you will not abandon my soul to Sheol. You will not hand over your faithful one to see the pit.
You make known to me the path of life; abundance of joys are before your face; in your right hand are delights forever!

verses.superscription: A prayer of David
verses.text:
Listen, Yahweh to righteousness. Pay attention to my cry!
Give ear to my prayer from lips without deceit.
Let my vindication come from your face; let your eyes see rightly!

You have examined my heart, you have visited me in the night,
you have tested me and have detected nothing. I have purposed that my mouth will not transgress.
With regard to the actions of man, by the word of your lips I have kept myself away from the paths of the violent.
My steps hold firmly to your tracks; my footsteps have not slipped.
I have called upon you, for you will answer me, God; Incline your ear to me; listen to my speech.
Set apart your covenant faithfulness, you, the one saving by your right hand the ones seeking refuge in you from those rising up!
Keep me as the pupil of your eye; hide me under the shadow of your wings,
from the faces of the wicked who deal violently with me, the ones being hostile against my soul, they surround me.
Their fat they have closed up; with their mouths they speak with pride.
They have surrounded me now in our steps. Their eyes they have set, crouching down to the earth.
His likeness is as a lion, he longs to tear; and as a young lion he is dwelling in hiding places.
Arise, Yahweh, confront his face, make him bow down! Rescue my soul from the wicked with your sword!

From men with your hand Yahweh, from men from the world, their portion in life,
and with your treasure you fill their belly. They are satisfied with sons, and they leave their abundance to their children.
I, in righteousness, will see your face; when I awake, I will be satisfied with your manifestation.

verses.superscription: To the chief musician. Of David, the servant of Yahweh, who spoke to Yahweh the words of this song on the day that Yahweh delivered him from the palm of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul.
verses.text: And he said, “I love you, Yahweh, my strength.

Yahweh is my rock and my stronghold and my deliverer; my God, my rock; I take refuge in him,
my shield and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.
To the one being praised I call, to Yahweh, and I am saved from my enemies.
The cords of death encompassed me, and the torrents of wickedness terrified me.
The cords of Sheol surrounded me; the snares of death confronted me.

In my distress, I called to Yahweh, and to my God I cried out for help. He heard my voice from his temple,
and my cry to his face went in his ears.

Then the earth shook and trembled, and the foundations of the mountains quaked
and shook themselves because it burned to him.
Smoke went up from his nose, and fire from his mouth devoured. Coals from him burned.
And he lowered the heavens, and he came down, and a dark cloud was under his feet.
And he rode on a cherub, and he flew, and he flew swiftly on the wings of the wind.
He set darkness his covering, the booth around him was a darkness of waters, clouds of the skies.
From the brightness before him, hailstones and coals of fire broke through his thick clouds.
And Yahweh thundered in the heavens and the Most High uttered his voice, hailstones and coals of fire.

footnotes.text: Some modern versions add after shouted, “hailstones and coals of fire” this expression may be an accidental repetition from the previous verse.

verses.text: And he sent out his arrows and he scattered them and lightnings in abundance and he panicked them.

And the channels of the sea were seen,
and the foundations of the world were uncovered,
from your rebuke, Yahweh,
from the blast of the breath of your nose.
He stretched out from the height, he took hold of me. He drew me out of many waters.
He delivered me from my strong enemy, from the ones hating me, for they were stronger than me.
They confronted me on the day of my calamity, but Yahweh was my support!
And he brought me out to an open space; he delivered me because he delighted in me.
Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands he has given back to me.
For I have kept the ways of Yahweh, and I have not been wicked from my God.
For all of his judgments are before me, and his statutes, I have not turned away from them.
And I have been blameless with him, and I have kept myself from my iniquity.
And Yahweh has given back to me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands before his eyes.

With the faithful you show yourself faithful;
with a blameless man, you show yourself blameless.
With the purified, you show yourself pure, but with the crooked, you show yourself cunning.
For you save a lowly people, but the eyes of the ones being high, you bring them down.
For you light my lamp; Yahweh my God lightens my darkness.
For by you I run after a troop, and by my God I leap over a wall.

This God, his way is perfect. The word of Yahweh is refined.
He is a shield to all of the ones taking refuge in him.
For who is God except Yahweh? And who is a rock except our God?
This God is the one girding me with valor, and he makes my way perfect,
making my feet like a deer, and he makes me stand on my high places,
training my hands for war, and my arms bend a bow of bronze.
And you give to me the shield of your salvation, and your right hand supports me, and your humility makes me great.
You enlarge my step under me, and my feet do not slip.
I pursue my enemies, and I destroy them, and I do not return until I have ended them.
I severely wounded them so that they were not able to rise; they fell under my feet.
And you gird me with valor for war; you make the ones rising up under me bow down.
And my enemies, you give to me the back of their neck; the ones hating me, I destroyed them.
They called out for help, but there was none saving; to Yahweh, but he did not answer them.
And I beat them fine as dust upon the face of the wind; like the mud of the streets I cast them out.
You rescue me from the disputes of people. You made me as the head of nations. People I did not know serve me.
At the hearing of an ear, they hear me; sons of the foreigner cringe to me.
Sons of the foreigner fade away, and they come trembling from their fortresses.
Yahweh is alive! And blessed be my rock, and may the God of my salvation be exalted,
the God giving vengeance to me, and he subdues peoples under me,
the one delivering me from my enemies. Also, from the ones arising against me you lift me up, from a man of violence, you deliver me.
Therefore, I thank you among the nations, Yahweh; and I will sing praise to your name,
the one magnifying the salvation of his king and doing covenant faithfulness to his anointed, to David, and to his seed until forever.”

verses.superscription: To the chief musician; a psalm of David
verses.text:
The heavens are declaring the glory of God,
and the sky is proclaiming the work of his hands.

Day to day makes flow forth a word,
and night to night declares knowledge.
There is no speech and there are no words, their voice is not being heard.

Their line has gone out through all of the earth,
and their words to the end of the world.
He has set in them a tent for the sun,

and that is like a bridegroom coming out from his chamber,
it rejoices like a strong man to run its path.

From the end of the heavens is its going forth,
and its circuit to the ends of them,
and there is nothing hidden from its heat.

The law of Yahweh is perfect, restoring the soul;
the testimony of Yahweh is sure, making wise the simple.

The precepts of Yahweh are right, making the heart rejoice;
the commandment of Yahweh is pure, enlightening the eyes.

The fear of Yahweh is clean, enduring forever;
the judgments of Yahweh are true, they are altogether righteous.

They are to be desired more than gold, and more than much fine gold,
and they are more sweet than honey and nectar of honeycombs.

Also, by them your servant is warned;
in keeping them there is great reward.

Who can discern his errors?
Acquit me from hidden faults.

Also, keep back your servant from presumptuous ones;
let them not rule over me.
Then I will be blameless,
and I will be innocent from great transgression.

Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart
be acceptable to your face,
Yahweh, my strength and the one redeeming me.

verses.superscription: To the chief musician; a psalm of David
verses.text:
May Yahweh answer you in the day of trouble;
may the name of the God of Jacob set you on high.

May he send you help from the sanctuary
and support you from Zion.

May he remember all of your grain offerings
and regard as fat your burnt offering. Selah

May he grant you according to your heart,
and may he fulfill all of your plans.

We will shout for joy over your salvation,
and in the name of our God we will set up our banners.
May Yahweh fulfill all of your petitions.

These in chariots and these in horses,
but we will remember the name of Yahweh our God.

They bow down and fall,
but we rise and stand upright!

Save, Yahweh;
may the king answer us on the day we call.

verses.superscription: To the chief musician; a psalm of David.
verses.text:
Yahweh, in your strength the king rejoices,
and in your salvation how greatly he exults!

You have given to him the desire of his heart,
and the request of his lips you have not withheld. Selah

For you meet him with blessings of good;
you place on his head a crown of refined gold.

He asked life from you; you gave it to him,
length of days, forever and ever.

His glory is great through your salvation;
splendor and majesty you place on him.

For you place on him eternal blessings;
you make him glad with joy with your face.

For the king is trusting in Yahweh,
and through the covenant faithfulness of the Most High, he will not be shaken.

Your hand will find all of your enemies;
your right hand will find the ones hating you.

You will make them as an oven of fire at the time of your face.
In his nose Yahweh will swallow them
and will consume them with fire.

You will destroy their fruit from the earth
and their seed from among the sons of man.

Though they stretch out evil against you,
they plan a plot they will not be able.

For you will make them shoulder;
on your strings you will set your arrows toward their faces.

Be exalted, Yahweh, in your strength;
we will sing and we will praise your power.

verses.superscription: For the chief musician; on “The Doe of the Dawn.” A psalm of David.
verses.text:
My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?
Why are you far from the salvation of me, far from the words of my groaning?

My God, I call by day, but you do not answer,
and in the night, and there is no silence for me.

Yet you are holy,
sitting in the praises of Israel.

In you our fathers trusted;
they trusted, and you delivered them.

To you they cried and they were rescued.
In you they trusted and they were not ashamed.

But I am a worm and not a man,
a reproach of mankind and despised by the people.

All of the ones seeing me mock me;
they open wide with the lip. They shake the head,

Yet you are the one pulling me out from the womb,
making me trust upon the breasts of my mother.

Upon you I was cast from the womb;
from the womb of my mother, you have been my God.

You do not be far away from me, for trouble is near,
for there is no one helping me.

Many bulls surround me;
strong ones of Bashan encircle me.

They open their mouths against me,
a tearing and roaring lion.

I am poured out like water,
and all of my bones are dislocated.
My heart is like wax;
it has melted within my inner parts.

My strength is dried up like a shard,
and my tongue is being made to cling to my gums,
and to the dust of death you lay me.

I can count all of my bones.
They look and they stare at me.

They divide my garments among them,
and they cast lots for my clothing.

But you, Yahweh, do not be far away.
My strength, hurry to help me.

Deliver my life from the sword,
my only one from the hand of the dog.

Save me from the mouth of the lion,
and from the horns of wild oxen, answer me.

I will declare your name to my brothers;
in the midst of the assembly I will praise you.

You who fear Yahweh, praise him!
All of the seed of Jacob, honor him,
and be terrified from him, all of the seed of Israel!

For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted,
and he has not hidden his face from him,
but when he cried to him, he heard.

From with you my praise in the great assembly;
I will fulfill my vows before those who fear him.

The poor will eat and be satisfied.
The ones seeking Yahweh will praise.
May your heart live forever.

All of the ends of the earth will remember and turn to Yahweh,
and all of the families of the nations will bow down to your face.

For to Yahweh the kingdom,
and he is ruling over the nations.

Seed will serve him;
it will be told of the Lord to the generation.

They will come and will declare his righteousness to a people who will be born,
that he has done it!

verses.superscription: A psalm of David
verses.text: Yahweh is my shepherd; I will lack nothing.

He makes me lie down in green pastures;
he leads me to waters of rest.

He restores my soul.
He leads me in right paths for the sake of his name.

Surely goodness and covenant faithfulness will pursue me all the days of my life,
and I will dwell in the house of Yahweh for length of days!

verses.superscription: A psalm of David
verses.text:
To Yahweh is the earth and its fullness,
the world and the ones dwelling in it.

For he has founded it upon the seas
and established it upon the rivers.

Who may ascend on the mountain of Yahweh?
And who may stand in his holy place?

The one clean of hands and pure of heart,
who has not lifted up his soul to what is false,
and has not sworn deceitfully.

He will take up a blessing from Yahweh
and righteousness from the God of his salvation.

This is the generation of the ones seeking him,
the ones seeking your face, Jacob. Selah

Lift up your heads, you gates,
and be lifted up, you ancient doors,
so that the King of Glory may come in.

Who is this King of Glory?
Yahweh, strong and mighty; Yahweh, mighty in battle.

Lift up your heads, you gates,
and lift up, you ancient doors,
so that the King of Glory may come in.

Who is he, this King of Glory?
Yahweh of Armies,
he is the King of Glory. Selah

verses.superscription: Of David
verses.text: To you, Yahweh, I lift up my soul.

Indeed, all the ones waiting on you will not have shame;
the ones acting treacherously without cause will have shame.

Make me know your ways, Yahweh;
teach me your paths.

Remember your compassion, Yahweh, and your covenant faithfulness,
for they are from ancient times.

Good and upright is Yahweh,
therefore he teaches the sinful in the way.

He leads the humble in justice,
and he teaches the humble his way.

All the paths of Yahweh are covenant love and faithfulness
for the ones keeping his covenant and his testimonies.

For the sake of your name, Yahweh,
forgive my iniquity, for it is great.

Who is the man fearing Yahweh?
He will teach him in the way he is to choose.

His soul will remain in good,
and his seed will inherit the earth.

The secret of Yahweh is for the ones fearing him
and his covenant, to cause them to know it.

My eyes are continually toward Yahweh,
for he will make my feet go out of the net.

Turn toward me and be gracious to me,
for I am alone and afflicted.

The troubles of my heart are enlarged;
bring me out of my distresses.

See my affliction and my trouble,
and forgive all of my sins.

See my enemies, for they are many,
and with hatred of violence they hate me.

Guard my life and deliver me;
do not let me have shame, for I take refuge in you!

May integrity and uprightness preserve me,
for I wait for you.

God, redeem Israel
from all of his troubles!

verses.superscription: Of David
verses.text:
Vindicate me, Yahweh, for I have walked in my integrity,
and in Yahweh I have trusted without wavering.

Examine me, Yahweh, and test me;
try my kidneys and my heart.

For your covenant faithfulness is before my eyes,
and I walk about in your truth.

I do not sit with men of falsehood,
and I will not go with the ones concealing themselves.

I hate the assembly of the ones doing evil,
and I will not sit with the wicked.

I wash my hands in innocence,
so I will go around your altar, Yahweh,

to cause to be heard the sound of thanksgiving
and recount all of your wonderful acts.

Yahweh, I love the habitation of your house,
and the place of the dwelling place of your glory.

Do not gather my soul with the sinful,
nor my life with men of blood,

who have in their hands an evil scheme
and their right hand is full of bribes.

But I will walk in my integrity;
redeem me and be gracious to me.

My foot stands on level ground;
among the assemblies will I bless Yahweh!

verses.superscription: Of David

verses.text:
When the ones doing evil advance against me to devour my flesh,
my enemies and the ones being hostile to me, they stumbled and fell.

Though an army encamps against me,
my heart will not fear;
though war arises against me,
in this I will be confident.

One thing I have asked from Yahweh, that I will seek:
that I may dwell in the house of Yahweh all the days of my life,
to look upon the beauty of Yahweh
and to inquire in his temple.

And now my head will be lifted up above the ones being hostile to me who are all around me,
and I will sacrifice in his tent sacrifices of a shout of joy.
I will sing and make music to Yahweh!

Hear, Yahweh, my voice when I cry out,
and be gracious to me, and answer me.

“Seek my face.” My heart said to you,
“Your face, Yahweh, I will seek.”

Do not hide your face from me;
do not turn your servant away in anger.
You have been my help.
Do not abandon me nor leave me, God of my salvation.

For my father and my mother have left me,
but Yahweh will care for me.

Teach me your way, Yahweh,
and lead me on a level path
because of my enemies.
Unless I had believed that I would look on the goodness of Yahweh in the land of the living.

Wait on Yahweh.
Be strong, and let your heart be courageous,
and wait on Yahweh.

verses.superscription: Of David
verses.text:
To you, Yahweh, I cry; my rock, do not be deaf to me,
lest you be deaf to me, and I be equal with those going down to the pit.

Hear the voice of my pleas when I cry to you for help,
when I lift up my hands toward your inner sanctuary of holiness.

Do not drag me away with the wicked and with the workers of iniquity,
the ones speaking of peace with their neighbors while evil is in their hearts.

Give to them according to their work and according to the evil of their deeds;
give to them according to the work of their hands; return to them their recompense.

Because they do not give heed to the works of Yahweh or the action of his hands,
he will tear them down and not build them up.

Blessed be Yahweh,
because he has heard the voice of my pleas.

Yahweh is strength for his people,
and he is a refuge of help for his anointed.

Save your people and bless your inheritance,
and shepherd them and carry them unto the eternity.

verses.superscription: A psalm of David
verses.text:
Ascribe to Yahweh, sons of God,
ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength.

Ascribe to Yahweh the glory of his name;
bow down to Yahweh in the adornment of holiness.

The voice of Yahweh over the waters,
the God of glory thunders,
Yahweh over many waters.

The voice of Yahweh is with power;
the voice of Yahweh is with majesty.

The voice of Yahweh is breaking cedars,
and Yahweh breaks the cedars of Lebanon.

And he makes Lebanon skip like a calf
and Sirion like a son of wild oxen.
The voice of Yahweh is hewing out with flames of fire.

The voice of Yahweh shakes the wilderness;
Yahweh shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.

The voice of Yahweh causes the deer to give birth
and strips the forests bare,
and in his temple everyone is saying, “Glory!”

Yahweh sits over the flood;
Yahweh sits as king forever.

Yahweh will give strength to his people;
Yahweh will bless his people with peace.

verses.superscription: A psalm a song at the dedication of the house; of David.
verses.text:
I will extol you, Yahweh,
for you have drawn me up
and have not let the ones being hostile
to me rejoice over me.

Yahweh my God,
I cried out to you for help,
and you healed me.

Sing praise to Yahweh, you his faithful ones,
and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.

For his anger is for a moment,
but his favor is for a lifetime.
In the evening weeping may come to lodge
but rejoicing comes in the morning.

And I, in my ease, said,
“I will never be shaken.”

To you, Yahweh, I cried out,
and to the Lord I pled for favor.

“What profit is there in my blood,
in my descent to the pit?
Will the dust praise you?
Will it declare your faithfulness?

Hear, Yahweh, and be gracious to me.
Yahweh, be my helper.”

in order that my glory may sing praise to you and not be silent.
Yahweh my God, I will give thanks to you forever.

verses.superscription: To the chief musician; a psalm of David.

verses.text:
Indeed, you are my rock and my stronghold;
therefore for the sake of your name you lead me and guide me.

You will pull me out of the net which they have secretly laid for me,
for you are my refuge.

Into your hand I commit my spirit;
you have redeemed me, Yahweh, God of faithfulness.

I hate the ones keeping idols of worthlessness,
but I trust in Yahweh.

and you have not delivered me into the hand of the ones being hostile to me;
you have set my feet in an open space.

Be gracious to me, Yahweh, for I am in distress;
my eye has wasted away from grief, my soul and my body.

For my life has come to an end with sorrow,
and my years with groaning;
my strength fails from my iniquity,
and my bones waste away.

Among all of the ones being hostile to me I have become a reproach,
and especially to my neighbors,
and dread to the ones knowing me;
the ones seeing me outside flee from me.

I have been forgotten like a dead man out of mind;
I am like a broken vessel.

For I hear the whispering of many—
terror on every side!—
while they conspire together against me;
they plan to take my life.

But I trust in you, Yahweh;
I say, “You are my God.”

My times are in your hand;
rescue me from the hand of the ones being hostile to me and from the ones pursuing me.

Make your face shine upon your servant;
save me in your covenant faithfulness.

Yahweh, do not let me have shame, for I have called upon you;
let the wicked have shame; let them be silent in Sheol.

Let lying lips be silenced,
the ones speaking insolent things against the righteous,
in pride and contempt.

How great is your goodness
which you have stored up for the ones fearing you,
which you have done for the ones taking refuge in you,
before the sons of man!

You hide them in the hiding-place of your presence from the plots of man;
you hide them in a shelter from the strife of tongues.

Blessed be Yahweh,
for he has shown marvelously his covenant faithfulness to me in a besieged city.

For I said in my alarm,
“I am cut off from your eyes.”
But indeed you heard the voice of my pleas when I cried out to you.

Love Yahweh, all you faithful ones!
Yahweh preserves the faithful,
but he pays back fully the proud person.

Be firm and let your heart be courageous,
all the ones waiting for Yahweh.

verses.superscription: A maskil of David
verses.text:
The happinesses of the one whose transgression is lifted up,
the one covered from sin!

The happinesses of the man to whom Yahweh reckons no guilt,
and in whose spirit there is no deceit!

When I kept silent, my bones wasted away
through my screaming all of the day.

For by day and night your hand was heavy upon me.
My vitality was changed as by the heat of summer. Selah

My sin I acknowledged to you,
and my guilt I did not cover.
I said, “I will confess my transgressions to Yahweh,”
and you lifted up the guilt of my sin. Selah

For this reason let everyone who is faithful pray to you at a time of finding;
surely in a flood of great waters, they will not reach to him.

I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you are to go.
I will counsel you with my eye upon you.

Many are the pains of the wicked,
but the one trusting in Yahweh, covenant faithfulness surrounds him.

Be glad in Yahweh and rejoice, righteous,
and shout for joy, all you upright of heart.

Shout for joy in Yahweh, righteous ones;
praise is fitting for the upright.

Give thanks to Yahweh with the harp;
with a lyre of ten strings, make music to him.

Sing to him a new song;
be skillful to play with a shout!

For the word of Yahweh is upright,
and all of his work is in faithfulness.

Loving righteousness and justice,
the covenant faithfulness of Yahweh fills the earth.

By the word of Yahweh, the heavens were made,
and by the breath of his mouth, all of their host.

Gathering the waters of the sea like a heap;
putting the deeps into storehouses,

let all of the earth fear Yahweh;
let all of the dwellers of the world be in dread of him.

For he, he spoke, and it came to be;
he, he commanded, and it stood.

Yahweh frustrates the counsel of nations;
he thwarts the plans of peoples.

The counsel of Yahweh stands forever,
the plans of his heart, to generation and generation.

The happiness of the nation which Yahweh is its God,
the people he chose for an inheritance for himself.

From the heavens, Yahweh looks down;
he sees all of the sons of man.

From the place of his dwelling he gazes
at all of the dwellers of the earth,

the one forming their hearts together,
the one understanding all of their works.

The king is not saved by a great army;
a warrior is not delivered by great strength.

The horse is a falsehood for salvation,
and by its great strength, it does not deliver.

Behold, the eye of Yahweh is toward the fearers of him,
toward those hoping for his covenant faithfulness,

to deliver their soul from death
and to keep them alive in the famine.

Our soul waits for Yahweh;
he is our help and our shield.

For in him our heart rejoices;
for in the name of his holiness we trust.

Let your covenant faithfulness, Yahweh, be upon us,
just as we have hoped in you.

verses.superscription: Of David; when he changed his behavior to the face of Abimelech and he sent him away and he left.
verses.text:
I shall bless Yahweh at all times;
continually his praise is in my mouth.

In Yahweh my soul will boast;
the humble will hear and rejoice.

Magnify Yahweh with me,
and let us exalt his name together.

I sought Yahweh, and he answered me,
and from all of my fears he delivered me.

They look to him and are radiant;
let their faces not have shame.

This afflicted one called, and Yahweh heard,
and from all of his troubles he saved him.

The angel of Yahweh is encamping around the fearers of him,
and he rescues them.

Taste and see that Yahweh is good;
the happinesses of the man—he takes refuge in him!

Fear Yahweh, his holy ones,
for there is no lack for the fearers of him.

Young lions are poor and hungry,
but the seekers of Yahweh will not lack any good thing.

Come, sons, listen to me;
the fear of Yahweh I will teach you.

Who is the man, the one desiring life,
loving days to see good?

Guard your tongue from evil,
and your lips from speaking deceit.

Turn away from evil and do good;
seek peace and pursue it.

The eyes of Yahweh are toward the righteous,
and his ears are toward their cry.

The face of Yahweh is against the doers of evil,
to cut off their remembrance from the earth.

They cry out, and Yahweh hears,
and from all of their troubles he delivers them.

Yahweh is near to the broken of heart,
and the crushed of spirit he saves.

Many are the evils of the righteous,
but Yahweh delivers him from all of them.

He is guarding all of his bones;
not one of them is broken.

Evil will put to death the wicked,
and the haters of the righteous will be guilty.

Yahweh is redeeming the soul of his servants,
and everyone taking refuge in him will not be guilty.

verses.superscription: Of David
verses.text:
Yahweh, oppose my opponents;
fight those fighting me.

Grab the small shield and large shield;
rise up as my helper!

Draw out spear and javelin to meet those chasing me;
say to my soul, “I am your salvation.”

May those who seek my life have shame and be dishonored.
May those who plan my harm be turned back and confounded.

May they be as chaff before the wind,
and the angel of Yahweh driving them away.

May their way be dark and slippery places,
and the angel of Yahweh chasing them.

For without cause they hid for me a pit, their net;
without cause they dug for my life.

Let destruction overtake him; he does not know.
Let the net that he hid catch him.
In destruction, let him fall into it.

But my soul will be joyful in Yahweh;
it will rejoice in his salvation.

All my bones will say, “Yahweh, who is like you,
rescuing the oppressed from those stronger than them
and the oppressed and needy from those robbing them?”

Witnesses of violence rise up;
what I do not know they ask me.

They repay me evil in place of good—
bereavement to my soul.

As for a friend, as for a brother to me, I walked about;
as one lamenting for a mother, mourning, I bowed down.

Among godless mockers of food,
they gnashed their teeth at me.

Lord, how long will you look on?
Restore my soul from their destructions,
my only one from the young lions!

I will thank you in the great assembly;
I will praise you among many people.

Do not let my deceitful enemies rejoice over me;
let not the haters of me without cause wink the eye.

For they do not speak peace,
and against the quiet ones of the earth
they devise words of deceits.

They open their mouth wide against me;
they say, “Aha, Aha, our eyes have seen.”

You have seen, Yahweh; do not be silent;
Lord, do not be far from me.

Awake and arouse yourself for my justice,
my God and my Lord, for my cause.

Judge me according to your righteousness, Yahweh my God,
and do not let them rejoice over me.

Do not let them say in their heart, “Aha, our soul!”
Do not let them say, “We have swallowed him up.”

Let them be ashamed and confounded together,
those rejoicing at my evil.
Let them be clothed with shame and humiliation,
the ones magnifying themselves against me.

Let them shout for joy and be glad,
those delighting in my righteousness,
and let them say continually, “Let Yahweh be great,
the one delighting in the peace of his servant.”

And my tongue will meditate on your righteousness,
all the day, your praise.

verses.superscription: For the chief musician; of the servant of Yahweh; of David.
verses.text:
The declaration of transgression to the wicked is in the midst of my heart:
there is no dread of God before his eyes.

For it is slippery to him in his eyes
to find his iniquity to hate it.

The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit;
he has ceased to act wisely, to do good.

Yahweh, your covenant faithfulness is in the heavens;
your trustworthiness, to the clouds.

How precious is your covenant faithfulness, God!
And the sons of man take refuge in the shadow of your wings.

They are refreshed from the fatness of your house,
and from the river of your delights you give them drink.

For with you is the fountain of life;
in your light we see light.

Extend your covenant faithfulness to the knowers of you,
and your righteousness to the upright of heart.

Let not the foot of pride come to me,
and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.

There the doers of iniquity have fallen;
they are thrust down and are not able to rise.

verses.superscription: Of David
verses.text:
Do not be upset about evildoers;
do not be envious of the doers of unrighteousness.

For like the grass they will quickly wither,
and like a green plant they will fade.

Trust in Yahweh and do good;
inhabit the land and feed faithfulness.

And delight yourself in Yahweh,
and he will give to you the desires of your heart.

Roll your way upon Yahweh,
and trust in him, and he, he will act

and he will bring out your righteousness like the light,
and your justice like the noonday.

Be silent to Yahweh and tremble for him.
Do not be angry because of the one making his way prosper,
because of a man doing schemes.

Let go of nose and abandon wrath;
do not be angry; only to cause evil.

For evildoers will be cut off,
but the ones waiting for Yahweh, they, they will inherit the land.

And yet a little and there are no wicked;
then you will look carefully at his place, but he is not.

But the meek will inherit the land
and will delight themselves over an abundance of peace.

The wicked is plotting against the righteous
and is gnashing his teeth against him.

The Lord laughs at him,
for he sees that his day is coming.

The wicked have opened a sword and have trodden their bow
to bring down the poor and the needy,
to slaughter the upright of way.

Their sword will come into their heart,
and their bows will be broken.

Better is the little of the righteous
than the abundance of many wicked.

For the arms of the wicked will be broken,
but Yahweh is supporting the righteous.

Yahweh is knowing the days of the blameless,
and their inheritance will be forever.

They will not have shame in a time of evil,
and in the days of famine they will have enough.

The wicked is borrowing and does not repay,
but the righteous is showing grace and giving.

For those blessed by him will inherit the land,
but those cursed by him will be cut off.

From Yahweh the steps of a man are established,
and he delights in his way.

Though he falls, he will not be hurled down,
for Yahweh is supporting his hand.

I was a youth, and I am old,
and I have not seen the righteous abandoned
or his seed seeking bread.

All the day he is showing grace and lending,
and his seed are for a blessing.

Turn away from evil and do good,
and dwell forever.

For Yahweh is loving justice,
and he will not abandon his faithful.
Forever they are preserved,
but the offspring of the wicked will be cut off.

The righteous will inherit the land
and will dwell forever upon it.

The mouth of the righteous murmurs wisdom,
and his tongue speaks justice.

The law of his God is in his heart;
his steps will not slip.

The wicked is watching the righteous
and is seeking to kill him.

Yahweh will not abandon him into his hand,
and will not condemn him when he is judged.

Wait for Yahweh and keep his way,
and he will raise you up to inherit the land.
When the wicked are cut off, you will see it.

I have seen a wicked, violent one,
and spreading himself out like a green native tree.

And he passed away, and behold, he was not,
and I sought him, and he was not found.

Watch the blameless and see the upright,
for there is a future for the man of peace.

But the transgressors are destroyed together;
the future of the wicked is cut off.

And the salvation of the righteous is from Yahweh,
their fortress in the time of distress.

verses.superscription: A psalm of David; to bring to remembrance.
verses.text:
Yahweh, do not rebuke me in your anger,
nor discipline me in your wrath.

For your arrows have sunk into me,
and your hand has come down on me.

There is no soundness in my flesh from the face of your indignation;
there is no peace in my bones from the face of my sin.

For my iniquities have passed over my head;
like a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.

My wounds stink, they fester
from the face of my foolishness.

I am twisted; I am bowed down exceedingly;
all the day I go about mourning.

For my loins are full of burning,
and there is no soundness in my flesh.

I am numb and crushed exceedingly;
I roar from the groaning of my heart.

Lord, all of my desire is before you,
and my sighing is not hidden from you.

My heart pounds; my strength has left me,
and the light of my eyes—even they are not with me.

My loved ones and my friends stand from before my plague,
and my relatives stand from afar.

And the seekers of my life lay snares,
and the pursuers of my harm speak destructions
and mutter treacheries all the day.

But I am like a deaf man; I do not hear,
and like a mute man—he does not open his mouth.

And I am like a man who is not hearing,
and there are no rebukes in his mouth.

Because for you, Yahweh, I have waited;
you, you will answer, Lord my God.

For I said, “Lest they rejoice over me;
at the slipping of my foot, they magnify themselves against me.”

For I am set up for a stumbling,
and my pain is before me continually.

For I declare my iniquity;
I am anxious because of my sin.

But my living enemies are strong,
and my haters of falsehood are many.

And the repayers of evil in exchange for good
accuse me in exchange for my pursuing of good.

Do not forsake me, Yahweh;
my God, do not be far from me.

Hurry to my help,
Lord, my salvation.

verses.superscription: For the chief musician; on Jeduthun. A psalm of David.
verses.text:
I said, “Let me guard my ways
from sinning with my tongue.
Let me guard a muzzle for my mouth
while the wicked is before me.”

“Make me know my end, Yahweh,
and the measure of my days, what it is.
May I know how transient I am.

Behold, you have given my days as handbreadths,
and my lifetime is as nothing before you.
Surely every man stands as all vapor. Selah

Surely a man walks about as an image;
surely they make an uproar for vapor.
He heaps up and does not know
who will be gathering them.

And now, what do I wait for, Lord?
My hope, it is for you.

Deliver me from all my transgressions;
do not make me the reproach of a fool.

I am mute; I do not open my mouth,
for you, you have done it.

Remove your plague from upon me;
from the blow of your hand, I, I am finished.

With rebukes on account of iniquity you discipline a man,
and you dissolve like a moth his desired thing.
Surely all mankind is vapor. Selah

Hear my prayer, Yahweh,
and give ear to my cry for help.
Do not be deaf to my weeping,
for I am a sojourner with you,
a foreigner like all my fathers.

Look away from me that I may be cheerful
before I go and I am no more.”

verses.superscription: For the chief musician; of David; a psalm
verses.text:
Waiting, I waited for Yahweh,
and he inclined to me
and heard my cry.

And he put a new song in my mouth,
praise to our God.
Many will see and will fear
and will trust in Yahweh.

The happinesses of the man who has made
Yahweh his trust,
and has not turned to the proud
and the goers aside to falsehood!

Many things you have done, you,
Yahweh my God,
your wonderful deeds and your thoughts toward us;
there is none to line up against you.
Should I declare and speak them,
they are more than to recount.

Sacrifice and grain offering you have not desired;
ears you have dug for me.
Burnt offering and sin offering
you have not asked for.

Then I said, “Behold, I have come;
in the scroll of the book it is written about me.

To do your will, my God, I have delighted,
and your law is in the midst of my inward parts.”

I have not concealed your righteousness in the midst of my heart;
I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation.
I have not hidden your covenant faithfulness and your trustworthiness
from the great assembly.

For evils have surrounded me
until there is no number;
my iniquities have overtaken me,
and I am not able to see.
They are more numerous than the hairs of my head,
and my heart has abandoned me.

Be pleased, Yahweh, to rescue me;
Yahweh, hurry to my help.

Let them have shame and have disgrace together,
the seekers of my life to sweep it away.
Let them be turned back and be confounded,
those pleased with my harm.

Let them be appalled on account of their shame,
the ones saying to me, “Aha! Aha!”

verses.superscription: For the chief musician; a psalm of David
verses.text:
The happinesses of the one considering the lowly!
In the day of evil, Yahweh will rescue him.

Yahweh will support him on the bed of suffering;
you transformed each bed of his in his sickness.

I, I said, “Yahweh, be gracious to me!
Heal my soul, for I have sinned against you.”

My enemies say evil concerning me,
“When will he die and his name perish?”

Together against me all my haters whisper;
against me they plan evil to me.

“A matter of wickedness is poured on him,
and he who has lain down will not repeat to rise.”

Even the man of my peace, whom I trusted in him,
the eater of my bread,
has made great the heel against me.

But you, Yahweh, be gracious to me and raise me up,
so that I may repay them.

By this I know that you delight in me,
that my enemy does not shout over me.

And I, in my integrity you upheld me,
and you set me to your face forever.

Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel,
from the everlasting and unto the everlasting.
Amen and amen.

verses.superscription: For the chief musician. A maskil of the sons of Korah.
verses.text:
As a deer pants for streams of water,
so my soul pants for you, God.

My soul thirsts for God, for the living God.
When will I come and appear to the face of God?

My weeping is bread to me day and night,
in their saying to me all of the day, “Where is your God?”

Let me remember these,
and let me pour out my soul within me,
that I went over with the crowd.
I led them in procession to the house of God
with a voice of rejoicing and praise,
a multitude celebrating a festival.

Why have you bowed yourself down, my soul,
and are clamoring within me?
Wait for God, for I will again thank him,
the salvation of his face.

My God, my soul has bowed itself down within me.
Therefore I will remember you
from the land of the Jordan and the Hermons,
from Mount Mizar.

Deep is calling to deep at the sound of your waterfalls.
All of your breakers and your waves pass over me.

By day, Yahweh commands his covenant faithfulness,
and at night, his song is with me,
a prayer to the God of my life.

Let me say to God, my rock,
“Why have you forgotten me?
Why do I walk about mourning
because of the oppression of the enemy?”

With crushing in my bones,
the ones afflicting me reproach me
in their saying to me all of the day,
“Where is your God?”

Why have you bowed yourself down, my soul,
and why are you clamoring within me?
Wait for God, for I will again thank him,
the salvation of my face and my God.

Vindicate me, God, and plead my plea against a nation not faithful.
Rescue me from a deceitful and unjust man.

For you are the God of my refuge.
Why have you rejected me?
Why do I walk about mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

Send out your light and your faithfulness,
them, let them lead me.
Let them bring me to the mountain of your holiness
and to your dwellings.

Let me come to the altar of God,
to the God of the joy of my gladness.
I will thank you with the lyre,
God, my God.

Why have you bowed yourself down, my soul,
and why are you clamoring within me?
Wait for God, for I will again thank him,
the salvation of my face and my God.

verses.superscription: For the chief musician. A maskil of the sons of Korah.
verses.text:
God, we have heard with our ears,
our fathers have recounted to us,
the work you worked in their days,
in the days of antiquity.

You, you drove out the nations by your hand,
but you planted them.
You caused harm to the peoples,
but you sent them.

For they did not possess the land with their sword,
and their arm did not save them,
but your right hand and your arm and the light of your face,
for you favored them.

You are he, my king, God.
Command the salvation of Jacob.

By you we gore our enemies;
by your name we trample the ones arising against us.

For I do not trust in my bow,
and my sword does not save me,

but you save us from our enemies,
and you shame the ones hating us.

In God we boast all of the day,
and we will praise your name forever. Selah

But you have rejected and humiliated us,
and you do not go out with our armies.

You make us turn back from the enemy,
and the ones hating us plunder for themselves.

You have made us like sheep of food,
and you have scattered us among the nations.

You have sold your people for not-wealth,
and you have not increased by their price.

You have made us a reproach to our neighbors,
a scorn and a derision to those around us.

You have made us a proverb among the nations,
a shaking of the head among the peoples.

All of the day my disgrace is before me,
and the shame of my face covers me,

from the voice of one reproaching and one reviling,
from the face of an enemy and one avenging.

All of this has come to us,
but we have not forgotten you
and we have not dealt falsely with your covenant.

Our heart has not turned itself back,
nor have our steps turned aside from your way.

But you have crushed us into a place of jackals,
and you have covered over us with a dark shadow.

If we had forgotten the name of our God
and spread out our palms to a foreign god,

would God not have discovered this?
For he is knowing the secrets of the heart.

But because of you we are killed all of the day,
we are considered like sheep of slaughter.

Awake! Why are you sleeping, Lord?
Wake up! Do not reject us forever!

Why do you hide your face,
forget our affliction and our oppression?

For our soul has sunk down into the dust,
our belly clings to the earth.

Arise as a helper to us
and redeem us because of your covenant faithfulness.

verses.superscription: For the chief musician; on “Lilies.” A maskil of the sons of Korah; a song of loves.
verses.text:
My heart boils over with a good matter.
I am reciting my works to the king.
My tongue is the stylus of a quick scribe.

You are fairer than the sons of man.
Grace is poured onto your lips.
Therefore God has blessed you forever.

Gird your sword on your thigh, warrior,
in your glory and your majesty.

And in your majesty prosper, ride out
for the sake of truth and humility and righteousness.
May your right hand teach you fearful things.

Your throne, God, is forever and ever.
A scepter of justice is the scepter of your kingdom.

You love righteousness, and you hate wickedness.
Therefore God, your God, has anointed you
with the oil of joy more than your companions.

Myrrh and aloes, cassia, are all of your garments.
From palaces of ivory, stringed instruments make you rejoice.

Daughters of kings are among your precious ones.
The queen is stationed at your right hand in gold of Ophir.

Listen, daughter, and consider, and incline your ear,
and forget your people and the house of your father.

Then the king will desire your beauty.
Because he is your lord, prostrate yourself to him.

The daughter of Tyre with a gift;
the rich of the people will entreat your face.

All glorious is the daughter of the king within;
from interweavings of gold is her clothing.

She will be led to the king in embroidery.
The virgins after her, her companions,
will be brought to you.

They will be led by joy and rejoicing;
they will enter into the palace of the king.

In place of your fathers will be your sons;
you will make him princes in all of the earth.

Let me make people remember your name in every generation to generation;
therefore the peoples will thank you forever and ever.

verses.superscription: For the chief musician. Of the sons of Korah. On “Maidens.” A song.
verses.text:
God is to us a refuge and strength,
being found greatly a help in trouble.

Therefore we will not fear in the changing of the earth
and the shaking of the mountains into the heart of the seas,

should its waters roar and foam,
should the mountains quake at its swelling. Selah

A stream, its channels make the city of God rejoice,
the holy place of the dwellings of the Most High.

God is in the midst of her, she will not be shaken.
God will help her at the turning of the morning.

Nations may roar; kingdoms may shake.
He utters with his voice; the earth melts.

Yahweh of Armies is with us;
the God of Jacob is a stronghold to us. Selah

Come, see the works of Yahweh,
who makes desolations on the earth,

“Be still and know that I am God.
I will be high among the nations, I will be high on the earth.”

Yahweh of Armies is with us;
the God of Jacob is a stronghold to us. Selah

verses.superscription: For the chief musician. A psalm of the sons of Korah.
verses.text:
Clap a palm, all peoples!
Shout to God with a voice of rejoicing.

For Yahweh, the Most High, is to be feared,
the great king over all of the earth.

He subdues peoples under us
and nations under our feet.

He chose our inheritance for us,
the pride of Jacob, whom he loved. Selah

God has gone up with a shout,
Yahweh with the sound of a shofar.

Sing praise to God, sing praise!
Sing praise to our king, sing praise!

For God is the king of all of the earth.
Sing praise with a maskil.

God reigns over the nations;
God sits on the throne of his holiness.

The nobles of the peoples will gather themselves
as the people of the God of Abraham,
for to God are the shields of the earth.
He is greatly exalted!

verses.superscription: A song. A psalm of the sons of Korah.
verses.text:
Yahweh is great, and he is being praised greatly
in the city of our God, on the mountain of his holiness.

Beautiful of elevation, the joy of all of the earth,
is Mount Zion in the recesses of the north,
the city of the great king.

God is in her citadels.
He is known as a stronghold.

For behold, kings assembled themselves,
they advanced together.

They, they saw, then they marveled.
They were terrified, they hastened themselves away.

Trembling seized them there,
pain like childbearing.

With the wind of the east,
you shatter ships of Tarshish.

As we have heard, so we have seen
in the city of Yahweh of Armies, in the city of our God.
God will establish it to forever. Selah

We have compared your covenant faithfulness, God,
in the midst of your temple.

As is your name, God,
so is your praise to the ends of the earth.
Your right hand is full of righteousness.

Circle Zion and go around her.
Count her towers,

put your heart to her rampart, consider her citadels,
so that you may recount to a later generation.

For this God is our God forever and ever.
He, he will guide us until death.

verses.superscription: For the chief musician. A psalm of the sons of Korah.
verses.text:
Hear this, all peoples!
Listen, all dwellers of the world,

both sons of a human and sons of a man,
the rich and the poor together.

My mouth will speak wisdom,
and the meditation of my heart, understanding.

I will incline my ear to a proverb;
I will open my enigma with a harp.

Why should I fear in the days of evil,
when the iniquity of my heels surrounds me,

the ones trusting in their wealth,
and in the abundance of their treasure they boast?

Redeeming, a man does not redeem a brother,
he does not give his ransom to God.

For the redemption of their life is costly,
and it ceases forever,

that one should live on forever,
that one should not see the pit.

For one will see.
The wise die, likewise the fool and the brute perish,
and they leave their wealth to others.

Inside of them, their houses are forever,
their dwellings are to generation and generation.
They call over lands by their names.

But a human does not abide in honor.
He is likened to the beasts, they are destroyed.

This, their way, is folly to them,
but after them, they delight in their mouths. Selah

Like sheep, they appoint them to Sheol;
death will shepherd them.
And the upright will rule over them in the morning,
and Sheol will consume their form from the dwelling to it.

But God will redeem my soul from the hand of Sheol,
for he will take me. Selah

Do not fear when a man becomes rich,
when the glory of his house increases.

For in his death, he will not take anything;
his glory will not go down after him.

Although in his life he blesses his soul
(and they do praise you when you do well for yourself),

he will come to the generation of his fathers;
forever they will not see light.

A human in honor, but he does not understand,
he is likened to the beasts, they are destroyed.

verses.superscription: A Psalm of Asaph
verses.text:
The God of gods, Yahweh, has spoken,
and he has summoned the earth
from the rising of the sun to its setting.

From Zion, the perfection of beauty,
God has shined forth.

Our God comes, and he is not silent.
A fire devours to his face,
and around him it is stormed greatly.

He calls to the heavens above and to the earth
so that he may judge his people.

“Gather my faithful ones to me,
the cutters of my covenant by sacrifice.”

The heavens declare his righteousness,
that God, he is judge. Selah

I do not accuse you regarding your sacrifices,
for your burnt offerings are always before me.

I will not take a bull from your house,
goats from your folds.

For every beast of the forest is to me,
the cattle on a thousand hills.

I know all the birds of the mountains,
and the creature of the field is with me.

If I were hungry, I would not say that to you,
for the world and its fulness are to me.

Do I eat the flesh of bulls,
or do I drink the blood of goats?

Sacrifice a thank offering to God,
and pay your vows to the Most High.

Call on me in the day of trouble;
I will deliver you, and you will glorify me.”

But to the wicked one God says,
“What to you to recount my statutes,
or that you should lift up my covenant onto your mouth?

For you, you hate instruction,
and you cast my words behind you.

When you see a thief, you approve of him,
and you partake with adulterers.

You send your mouth in evil,
and your tongue frames deceit.

You sit, you speak against your brother;
you impute slander against the son of your mother.

You have done these things,
but I have been silent.
You thought the being of I AM was like you.
I will accuse you,
and let me array to your eyes.

Consider this now, forgetters of God,
lest I tear and none be delivering!

The one sacrificing a thank offering glorifies me,
and the one placing a way,
I will make him look upon the salvation of God.”

verses.superscription: For the chief musician. A psalm of David, when Nathan the prophet came to him after he had gone in to Bathsheba.
verses.text:
Be merciful to me, God, according to your covenant faithfulness.
According to the multitude of your compassions, wipe away my transgressions.

Make great, wash me from my iniquity,
and cleanse me from my sin.

For I, I know my transgressions,
and my sin is always before me.

Against you, you only, I have sinned
and done evil in your eyes,
so you are right in your speaking,
you are blameless in your judging.

Behold, I was born in iniquity,
and in sin my mother conceived me.

Behold, you desire truth in the kidneys,
and you teach me wisdom in the closed place.

May you purify me with hyssop, that I may be clean.
May you wash me, that I may be whiter than snow.

Make me hear joy and gladness;
may the bones you have crushed rejoice.

Hide your face from my sins,
and wipe away all of my iniquities.

Create for me a clean heart, God,
and renew an established spirit within me.

May you not cast me away from your face,
and may you not take the Spirit of your holiness from me.

Restore to me the joy of your salvation,
and support me with a willing spirit.

Let me teach transgressors your ways,
that sinners may return to you.

Deliver me from blood, God, the God of my salvation,
may my tongue sing about your righteousness.

Lord, may you open my lips,
that my mouth may declare your praise.

For you do not delight in sacrifice, or I would give it;
you do not accept a burnt offering.

The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit.
A broken and crushed heart, God, you will not despise.

Do good to Zion in your acceptance;
build the walls of Jerusalem.

Then you will delight in sacrifices of righteousness,
a burnt offering and a whole one.
Then they will offer bulls on your altar.

verses.superscription: For the chief musician. A maskil of David. When Doeg the Edomite came and declared to Saul and said to him, “David came to the house of Ahimelech.”
verses.text:
Why do you boast about harm, O warrior?
The covenant faithfulness of God all of the day.

Like a sharpened razor, your tongue devises calamities,
worker of betrayal!

You love evil more than good,
lying more than speaking righteousness. Selah

You love all words of destruction,
tongue of betrayal!

God will also tear you down forever.
He will take you away and tear you from the tent
and uproot you from the land of the living. Selah

And the righteous will see and fear,
and they will laugh at him.

But I am like a green olive tree in the house of God.
I will trust in the covenant faithfulness of God forever and ever.

I will thank you forever,
for you have done this.
I will await your name,
for it is good before your faithful ones.

verses.superscription: For the chief musician; on “Weakness.” A maskil of David.
verses.text:
The fool says in his heart, “No God.”
They are corrupt, and they do iniquity abominably.
There is none doing good.

God looks down from the heavens on the sons of man
to see whether there is one understanding,
one seeking God.

All of him has turned away.
Together they have corrupted themselves.
There is none doing good, not even one.

Do they not know, the doers of iniquity,
the ones eating my people as they eat bread?
They do not call upon God.

There they feared a fear when no fear was,
because God scattered the bones of the one encamping against you.
You have shamed them,
for God despises them.

Who will give the salvation of Israel from Zion?
When God restores the prosperity of his people,
Jacob will be glad, Israel will rejoice.

verses.superscription: For the chief musician; with stringed instruments. A maskil of David. When the Ziphites came and said to Saul, “Is not David hiding himself among us?”
verses.text:
Save me, God, by your name,
and vindicate me by your might.

Hear my prayer, God;
listen to the words of my mouth.

For foreigners have arisen against me,
and violent ones seek my life.
They do not set God before them. Selah

Behold, God is a helper to me;
the Lord is with the sustainers of my life.

He will return harm to my enemies.
In your faithfulness, destroy them!

With a freewill offering, I will sacrifice to you.
I will praise your name, Yahweh, for it is good.

For he delivers me from every trouble,
and my eye looks at my enemies.

verses.superscription: For the chief musician; with stringed instruments. A maskil of David.
verses.text:
Listen to my prayer, God,
and do not hide yourself from my plea.

Attend to me and answer me.
I am restless in my complaint, and let me moan

from the voice of the enemy,
from the face of the oppression of the wicked.
For they shake trouble onto me,
and in nose they persecute me.

My heart writhes in the midst of me,
and the terrors of death have fallen onto me.

Fear and trembling have come on me,
and horror has covered me.

I have said, “Who will give the wing of a dove to me?
Let me fly away and let me dwell.

Behold, I would make distance, wandering;
I would lodge in the wilderness. Selah

Let me hasten for myself
to an escape from the storming wind,
from the tempest.”

Swallow them, Lord, divide their tongue!
For I have seen violence and strife in the city.

Day and night they go around it on its walls,
and iniquity and trouble are in the midst of it.

Calamity is in the midst of it,
and oppression and deceit do not depart from its open square.

But it was you, a man according to my valuation,
my companion and my acquaintance,

we who together made counsel sweet;
we walked in the house of God with the throng.

I, I will call to God,
and Yahweh will save me.

He redeems my life in peace from the battle against me,
for with many they are against me.

God will hear and answer them,
even the one sitting from antiquity, Selah
to whom there are no changes,
so they do not fear God.

He stretches out his hands against his friends;
he defiles his covenant.

The curds of his mouth were smooth,
but his heart was war.
His words were softer than oil,
but they were unsheathed swords.

Cast your burden on Yahweh,
and he, he will sustain you.
Forever he will not allow shaking to the righteous.

But you, God, will make them go down to the pit of the grave.
Men of blood and treachery will not halve their days.
But I, I will trust in you.

verses.superscription: For the chief musician; on “A Faraway Silent Dove.” Of David. A miktam. When the Philistines seized him in Gath.
verses.text:
Be gracious to me, God, for man tramples me!
All of the day, fighting, he oppresses me.

My enemies trample me all of the day,
for many are fighting against me arrogantly.

The day I fear,
I, I will trust in you.

In God—I praise his word—in God I trust.
I will not fear. What will flesh do to me?

All of the day they vex my matters;
all of their thoughts are against me for harm.

They gather together, they hide;
they, they watch my heels because they await my life.

Upon iniquity shall there be an escape for them?
In nose, make the peoples go down, God.

You, you record my wandering.
Put my tears in your bag.
Are they not in your record?

Then my enemies will turn back on the day I call.
This I know, for God is for me.

In God—I praise his word—
in Yahweh—I praise his word—

in God I trust.
I will not fear. What will man do to me?

Your vows are on me, God.
I will pay a thank-offering to you.

For you deliver my life from death.
Are not my feet from stumbling,
that I may walk about to the face of God in the light of the living?

verses.superscription: For the chief musician; “May You Not Destroy.” Of David; a miktam. When he fled from the face of Saul, in the cave.
verses.text:
Be gracious to me, God, be gracious to me,
for in you my soul takes refuge,
and in the shadow of your wings I take refuge
until the calamities have passed by.

I call to God Most High,
to God, the one accomplishing for me.

May he send from the heavens and save me.
May he reproach the one trampling me. Selah
May God send his covenant faithfulness and his truth.

My soul is in the midst of lions;
I must lie down among blazing ones, sons of man.
Their teeth are a spear and arrows,
and their tongue is a sharp sword.

Be high above the heavens, God,
may your glory be above all of the earth.

My heart is established, God, my heart is established.
Let me sing and make music.

Awake, my glory!
Awake, lyre and harp!
Let me awaken the dawn.

I will thank you, Lord, among the peoples;
I will make music to you among the nations.

For your covenant faithfulness is great to the heavens,
and your truth to the clouds.

Be high above the heavens, God,
may your glory be above all of the earth.

verses.superscription: For the chief musician; “May You Not Destroy.” Of David; a miktam.
verses.text:
Truly in silence do you speak righteousness?
Do you judge uprightly, sons of man?

No, in the heart you do wickedness.
Your hands weigh out violence on the earth.

The wicked turn aside from the womb;
they stray from the belly, speaking falsehood.

The poison to them is like the likeness of the poison of a serpent.
They are like a deaf adder that shuts its ears,

that does not listen to the voice of charmers,
one charming charms, being made wise.

God, break their teeth in their mouth!
Break out the fangs of the young lions, Yahweh!

May they be melted like waters that run off to them.
When he treads his arrows, may they be as if they are cut off.

May they be like a snail that melts; it goes away.
May they be like the miscarriage of a woman; they do not see the sun.

Before your pots perceive the thorn, like the living, like the burning,
he will whirlwind it away.

The righteous will rejoice when he sees vengeance.
He will wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.

Then man will say, “Truly, fruit is to the righteous.
Truly, there is a God judging the earth.”

verses.superscription: For the chief musician; “May You Not Destroy.” Of David; a miktam. When Saul sent and they watched the house to kill him.
verses.text:
Deliver me from my enemies, my God!
Set me on high, away from the ones rising up against me.

Deliver me from workers of iniquity,
and save me from men of blood.

For behold, they lie in wait for my life;
the mighty gather against me.
Not for my transgression
and not for my sin, Yahweh,

without iniquity, they run and prepare themselves.
Awake to meet me, and see!

So you, Yahweh, God of armies, the God of Israel,
wake up to punish all of the nations!
Do not be gracious to any treacherous workers of iniquity. Selah

They return at evening,
they growl like a dog and go around the city.

Behold, they belch out with their mouth,
swords are in their lips,
