they speak a tongue of untruth with me,

and words of hatred surround me,
and they attack me without cause.

In return for my love they accuse me,
but I—prayer.

They put upon me evil in return for good,
and hatred in return for my love.

Appoint a wicked one over him;
and may an accuser stand at his right hand.

When he is judged, may he come out guilty;
and may his prayer be as sin.

May his days be few;
may another take his position.

May his children be fatherless,
and his wife a widow.

And wandering, may his children wander and beg
and seek from their desolations.

May a creditor snare all that is to him;
may strangers plunder his work.

May there not be to him one extending covenant faithfulness;
and may there not be one pitying his orphans.

May his posterity be to cut off;
may their name be blotted out in the next generation.

May the sin of his fathers be remembered to Yahweh;
and the offense of his mother not be blotted out.

May they be before Yahweh continually
and may he cut off their remembrance from the earth,

because he never remembered to do covenant faithfulness,
but pursued the humble man and the needy
and the dejected in heart to death.

And he loved cursing, and it came to him,
and he did not delight in blessing, and it was far from him.

And he put on cursing as his garment,
and it entered into his inner being like water,
and like oil into his bones.

May it be to him like the clothing he wears,
and for the belt he always girds himself with it.

This, the payment of my accusers from Yahweh,
and those speaking evil against my soul.

But you, Yahweh, my Lord, do with me on account of your name.
Because your covenant faithfulness is good, rescue me!

For I am poor and needy,
and my heart breaks within me.

Like a shadow when it lengthens I am made to go;
I am shaken off like a locust.

My knees are weak from fasting
and my flesh is gaunt from fatness.

And I, I am a disgrace to them;
they see me; they shake their head.

Help me, Yahweh my God;
save me according to your covenant faithfulness,

so that they know that this is your hand;
you, Yahweh, you have done it.

May my accusers be clothed with disgrace;
may they wear their shame like a robe.

With my mouth I greatly thank Yahweh;
and in the midst of many I will praise him.

For he stands at the right hand of the needy,
to save him from the judges of his soul.

verses.superscription: Of David, a psalm.
verses.text:
The declaration of Yahweh to my lord the king:
“Sit at my right hand
until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.”

Yahweh will stretch out the scepter of your strength from Zion;
rule in the midst of your enemies!

Your people, freewill offerings on the day of your strength, in the beauty of holiness;
from the womb of the dawn, the dew of your youth is to you.

Yahweh has sworn, and will not revoke it:
“You are a priest forever,
after the manner of Melchizedek.”

The Lord is at your right hand.
He crushes kings on the day of his nose.

He will drink from the stream along the path,
Therefore, he will lift up the head.

Hallelu Yah!
I will thank Yahweh with the whole heart
in the assembly of the upright and congregation.

The works of Yahweh are great,
searched by everyone desirous of them.

His work is splendor and majesty,
and his righteousness stands forever.

He makes a remembrance for his wonders;
Yahweh is gracious and merciful.

He gives food to those fearing him.
He remembers his covenant forever.

He showed the power of his works to his people,
to give to them the inheritance of the nations.

The works of his hands are truth and justice;
all of his precepts are reliable.

They are established forever, for eternity,
done in faithfulness, and upright.

Hallelu Yah!
The happinesses of the man fearing Yahweh,
greatly delighting in his commandments!

His seed will be powerful on the earth;
a generation of upright ones will be blessed.

Wealth and riches are in his house,
and his righteousness stands forever.

Light shines in the darkness for the upright ones;
gracious and compassionate and just.

a gracious and lending man is good;
he conducts his affairs with justice.

For he will not be moved for forever;
the righteous will be for an eternal remembrance.

He does not fear bad news;
his heart is sure, trusting in Yahweh.

His heart is upheld, he does not fear,
until he looks over his adversaries.

Blessed be the name of Yahweh,
from now and to forever.

From the rising of the sun to its setting,
may the name of Yahweh be praised.

Yahweh is high above all nations;
his glory above the skies.

Who is like Yahweh our God,
the one making high to sit,

the one making low to look
on the sky and on the earth?

raising up the poor from the dust,
he lifts the needy from the garbage,

to seat him with princes,
with the princes of his people.

He causes the barren woman of the house to dwell,
the joyful mother of children!
Hallelu Yah!

When Israel went out from Egypt,
the house of Jacob from a people speaking a foreign language,

Judah became his sanctuary,
Israel his realm.

The sea looked and fled;
the Jordan turned backward.

The mountains skipped like rams,
the hills like sons of the flock.

What is to you, sea, that you flee?
Jordan, you turn backwards?

Mountains, you skip like rams,
hills, like sons of the flock?

Tremble, earth, from to the face of the Lord,
from to the face of the God of Jacob,

the one turning the rock into a pool of water,
flint into a spring of water!

Not to us, Yahweh, not to us,
but to your name give honor,
upon your covenant faithfulness, upon your trustworthiness.

Why should the nations say,
“Where, then, is their God?”

And our God is in heaven;
everything that he desires, he does.

Their idols are silver and gold,
the work of the hands of man.

A mouth is to them, but they do not speak;
eyes are to them, but they do not see;

ears are to them, but they do not hear;
a nose is to them, but they do not smell.

Their makers are like them—
everyone who is trusting in them.

Israel, trust in Yahweh;
he is their help and their shield.

House of Aaron, trust in Yahweh;
he is their help and their shield.

Fearers of Yahweh, trust in Yahweh;
he is their help and their shield.

He will bless those fearing Yahweh,
the small with the great.

May Yahweh add to you,
to you and to your sons.

May you be blessed by Yahweh,
the maker of heaven and earth.

The heavens of heavens are to Yahweh;
but the earth he has given to the sons of man.

The dead do not praise Yah,
and not any descending to silence;

But we, we will bless Yah
from now and to forever!
Hallelu Yah!

I love him because Yahweh hears
my voice, my pleas,

because he extends his ear to me;
and throughout my days I will call out.

Then I called on the name of Yahweh:
“Please Yahweh, rescue my life.”

Yahweh is merciful and righteous,
and our God is compassionate.

Yahweh guards the naive;
I was low, and he saved me.

Return to your rest, my soul,
for Yahweh has repaid you.

For you rescued my soul from death,
my eye from weeping,
my foot from stumbling.

I will walk to the face of Yahweh
in the lands of the living.

I trusted, though I spoke,
“I, I am very wretched.”

I, I said in my panic,
“All mankind lies.”

How can I return to Yahweh
all of his bestowments to me?

I will raise the cup of salvation,
and call on the name of Yahweh.

I will fulfill my vows to Yahweh
right in front of all of his people.

Precious in the eyes of Yahweh
is the death of his faithful.

I will sacrifice to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving
and I will call on the name of Yahweh.

I will fulfill my vows to Yahweh
right in front of all of his people,

in the courts of the house of Yahweh,
in your midst, Jerusalem.
Hallelu Yah!

Praise Yahweh, all nations;
extol him, all peoples!

For his covenant faithfulness is strong toward us,
and the trustworthiness of Yahweh is to forever.
Hallelu Yah!

Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good,
for his covenant faithfulness is to forever!

Let Israel indeed say,
“For his covenant faithfulness is to forever.”

Let the house of Aaron indeed say,
“For his covenant faithfulness is to forever.”

Let the fearers of Yahweh indeed say,
“For his covenant faithfulness is to forever.”

From the constriction I called out to Yah;
Yah answered me with wideness.

Yahweh is for me; I will not be afraid;
what can man do to me?

Yahweh is for me as my helper,
and I, I will gaze on the haters of me.

Better to take shelter in Yahweh
than to trust in man.

Better to take shelter in Yahweh
than to trust in princes.

All the nations surrounded me;
in the name of Yahweh, indeed I fended them off.

They surrounded me; yes, they surrounded me;
in the name of Yahweh, indeed I fended them off.

To push down, you pushed me down to fall,
but Yahweh helped me.

Yah is my strength and song,
and he is to me for salvation.

The voice of a shout and salvation is in the tents of the righteous;
the right hand of Yahweh does valor!

The right hand of Yahweh is high;
the right hand of Yahweh does valor!

I will not die, but live
and I will declare the deeds of Yah.

To chastise, Yah has chastised me;
but to death he has not given me.

Open to me the gates of righteousness;
I will enter them; I will thank Yah.

This is the gate of Yahweh;
the righteous may enter through it.

I will thank you, for you answered me,
and you have become salvation for me.

The stone that the builders rejected
has become the head of the corner.

This is from Yahweh;
it is marvelous in our eyes.

This is the day Yahweh made;
Let us rejoice and be glad in it.

Please, Yahweh, save please!
Please, Yahweh, give success please!

Blessed is the one coming in the name of Yahweh;
we bless you from the house of Yahweh.

Yahweh is God, and he has given light to us;
bind the sacrifice with cords to the horns of the altar.

You are my God, and I will thank you;
my God, I will exalt you.

Give thanks to Yahweh; for he is good;
for his covenant faithfulness is to forever!

verses.heading: ALEPH
verses.text:
The happinesses of the blameless of way,
the ones walking in the teaching of Yahweh!

The happinesses of the keepers of his testimonies!
They seek him with a whole heart.

Surely they do not practice injustice;
they walk in his ways.

You, you have commanded your precepts
to keep diligently.

Oh, that my paths would be established
to keep your statutes!

Then I would not have shame
when I look to all of your commandments.

I will thank you with uprightness of heart
when I learn the judgments of your righteousness.

I will keep your statutes;
do not utterly leave me.

verses.heading: BETH
verses.text:
How can a young man keep his path pure?
By keeping according to your word.

With all of my heart I seek you.
Do not let me stray from your commandments.

I have hidden your word in my heart
so that I might not sin against you.

Blessed are you, Yahweh;
teach me your statutes.

With my lips I have recounted
all of the judgments of your mouth.

I rejoice in the way of your testimonies
as upon all riches.

I will meditate on your precepts
and I will study your paths.

I delight in your statutes;
I will not forget your word.

verses.heading: GIMEL
verses.text:
Deal kindly with your servant
so that I may live and keep your word.

Uncover my eyes so that I may gaze
on the marvelous things from your teaching.

I am a sojourner in the land;
do not hide your commandments from me.

My soul languishes with longing
for your judgments at all times.

You rebuke the proud, the cursed,
those wandering from your commandments.

Roll from upon me disgrace and humiliation,
for I have guarded your testimonies.

Though rulers sit and discuss against me,
your servant meditates on your statutes.

Indeed, your testimonies are my pleasure,
my men of counsel.

verses.heading: DALETH
verses.text:
My soul clings to the dust!
Revive me according to your word.

I recounted my ways, and you answered me.
Teach me your statutes.

Make me understand the way of your precepts,
so that I can meditate on your wonders.

My soul melts from grief.
Lift me up by your word.

Turn from me the path of deceit,
and favor me with your teaching.

I have chosen the way of faithfulness;
I agree with your judgments.

I cling to your testimonies;
Yahweh, do not let me be shamed.

I run in the way of your commandments,
for you enlarge my heart.

verses.heading: HE
verses.text:
Teach me, Yahweh, the way of your statutes,
and I will keep it to the end.

Give me understanding, and I will guard your teaching,
and I will keep it with a whole heart.

Guide me in the path of your commandments,
for I delight in it.

Incline my heart toward your testimonies
and not toward unrighteous gain.

Turn away my eyes from looking at worthless things;
in your ways, revive me.

Fulfill for your servant your word,
which is for the fear of you.

Turn away my reproach, which I dread,
for your judgments are good.

Behold, I long for your precepts!
In your righteousness, revive me!

verses.heading: WAW
verses.text:
And let your covenant faithfulness come to me, Yahweh;
your salvation, according to your word;

then I will answer the one reproaching me with a word,
for I trust in your word.

So do not utterly snatch the word of truth from my mouth,
for I wait for your judgments.

Then I will observe your teaching continually,
forever and ever.

And I will walk about in the broad,
for I seek your precepts.

And I will speak of your testimonies before kings,
and I will not have shame.

And I delight in your commandments,
which I love.

And I will lift up my palms to your commandments, which I love,
and I will meditate on your statutes.

verses.heading: ZAYIN
verses.text:
Remember the word to your servant
by which you have given me hope.

This is my comfort in my affliction
because your promise revives me.

The proud utterly scoff at me;
from your teaching I do not turn aside.

I remember your judgments from ancient times, Yahweh,
and I comfort myself.

Rage has seized me
from the wicked rejecting your teaching.

Your statutes are music to me
in the house of my sojourning.

I remember your name during the night, Yahweh,
and I shall observe your teaching.

This is for me,
that I keep your precepts.

verses.heading: HETH
verses.text:
Yahweh is my portion;
I promise to observe your words.

I entreat your face with a whole heart;
be merciful to me according to your word.

I examine my ways
and turn my feet to your testimonies.

I hurry and do not delay
to observe your commandments.

The cords of the wicked ensnare me;
I do not forget your teaching.

In the middle of the night I rise to praise you
because of the judgments of your righteousness.

I am a companion to all who fear you
and to observers of your precepts.

Your covenant faithfulness fills the earth, Yahweh;
teach me your statutes.

verses.heading: TETH
verses.text:
You do good to your servant,
Yahweh, according to your word.

Teach me good discernment and understanding,
for I trust in your commandments.

Before I was afflicted, I was going astray,
but now I observe your word.

You are good, and you do good.
Teach me your statutes.

The arrogant smear lies on me;
I, with a whole heart, I keep your precepts.

Their hearts are unfeeling like fat,
I, in your teaching, I delight.

It is good for me that I have suffered
so that I would learn your statutes.

The teaching of your mouth is good for me,
more than thousands of gold and silver.

verses.heading: YODH
verses.text:
Your hands have made me and established me;
give me understanding so that I may learn your commandments.

May the fearful of you see me and rejoice
because I hope in your word.

Yahweh, I know that your judgments are just,
and in faithfulness you humble me.

Please may your covenant faithfulness be to comfort me,
according to your word to your servant.

May your compassion come to me so that I may live,
for your teaching is my delight.

May the fearful of you turn to me,
so that they may know your testimonies.

May my heart be blameless in your statutes,
so that I may not have shame.

verses.heading: KAPH
verses.text:
My soul faints for your salvation!
I wait for your word.

My eyes faint for your promise;
saying, “When will you comfort me?”

For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke;
I do not forget your statutes.

How many are the days of your servant?
When will you act in pursuing justice for me?

The proud have dug pits for me,
which is not according to your teaching.

All of your commandments are truth.
They pursue me in deceit; help me!

As a little they have made an end of me in the land,
but I, I have not rejected your precepts.

According to your covenant faithfulness, keep me alive,
so that I may observe the testimony of your mouth.

verses.heading: LAMEDH
verses.text:
Forever, Yahweh,
your word is established in the heavens.

Your faithfulness is to generation and generation;
you have established the earth, and it stands.

By your judgments, they stand today,
for all things are your servants.

If your teaching had not been my delight,
then I would have perished in my affliction.

I will not forget your precepts forever,
for through them you have preserved me alive.

I am yours; save me,
for I seek your precepts.

The wicked wait for me to destroy me;
I pay attention to your testimonies.

I have seen an end for all perfection;
your commandment is very broad.

verses.heading: MEM
verses.text:
How I love your teaching!
It is my meditation all the day.

Your commandment makes me wiser than my enemies,
for it is with me forever.

I have more insight than all my teachers,
for your testimonies are a meditation to me.

I understand more than the elders,
for I have kept your precepts.

I have restrained my feet from every evil path,
so that I might keep your word.

I have not turned aside from your judgments,
for you, you have taught me.

How your word is sweet to my palate,
more than honey to my mouth!

From your precepts I gain understanding;
therefore, I hate every path of falsehood.

verses.heading: NUN
verses.text:
Your word is a lamp to my foot
and a light to my path.

I have sworn and I will confirm it,
to keep the judgments of your righteousness.

I have been afflicted exceedingly;
Yahweh, revive me according to your word.

Please accept the freewill offerings of my mouth, Yahweh,
and teach me your judgments.

My soul is in my palm continually,
but I do not forget your teaching.

The wicked have set a snare for me,
but I have not wandered from your precepts.

I have inherited your testimonies forever,
for they are the joy of my heart.

I have inclined my heart to do your statutes
to forever, the end.

verses.heading: SAMEKH
verses.text:
The double-minded I have hated,
but your teaching I have loved.

My hiding place and my shield are you;
for your word I wait.

Turn aside from me, doers of evil,
and let me keep the commandments of my God.

Sustain me according to your word so that I may live,
and do not make me ashamed of my hope.

Support me so that I will be saved,
and so I may gaze on your statutes continually.

You reject all those straying from your statutes,
for their deceit is falsehood.

You cause to cease as dross all the wicked of the earth;
therefore, I love your testimonies.

My flesh shudders from dread of you,
and I fear your judgments.

verses.heading: AYIN
verses.text:
I have done justice and righteousness;
do not leave me to those oppressing me.

Be surety for your servant for good;
do not let the arrogant oppress me.

My eyes have failed for your salvation
and for the word of your righteousness.

Deal with your servant according to your covenant faithfulness,
and teach me your statutes.

I am your servant; give me understanding,
so that I can know your testimonies.

It is time for Yahweh to act;
they have broken your law.

Therefore, I love your commandments
more than gold and more than fine gold.

Therefore, all the precepts of everything I carefully observe;
every path of falsehood I hate.

verses.heading: PE
verses.text:
Your testimonies are wonderful;
therefore, my soul has kept them.

The doorway of your words gives light,
giving understanding to the simple.

I open wide my mouth and I pant,
for I long for your commandments.

Turn to me and be gracious to me,
according to the judgment for the ones loving your name.

Establish my steps in your word,
and do not let any iniquity rule over me.

Redeem me from the oppression of man,
that I may keep your precepts.

Make your face shine on your servant,
and teach me your statutes.

Streams of water go down from my eyes,
because they do not keep your law.

verses.heading: TSADE
verses.text:
Righteous are you, Yahweh,
and upright are your judgments.

You have commanded your testimonies in righteousness
and faithfulness exceedingly.

My zeal consumes me,
for my adversaries have forgotten your words.

Your word is refined exceedingly,
and your servant loves it.

Small am I and despised;
your precepts I have not forgotten.

Your righteousness is righteousness forever,
and your law is truth.

Narrow and distress have found me;
your commandments are my delight.

The righteousness of your testimonies is forever;
give me understanding, so that I may live.

verses.heading: QOPH
verses.text:
I call out with a whole heart; answer me, Yahweh!
I shall keep your statutes.

I call out to you; save me,
so that I may keep your testimonies.

I preempt the dawn and cry for help;
for your words I wait.

My eyes preempt the night watches,
to meditate on your word.

Hear my voice according to your covenant faithfulness;
Yahweh, according to your judgment, revive me.

The pursuers of evil purpose have drawn near;
from your law they are far away.

Near are you, Yahweh,
and all your commandments are truth.

Long ago, I knew from your testimonies
that you have founded them forever.

verses.heading: RESH
verses.text:
See my affliction and rescue me,
for I have not forgotten your law.

Plead my plea and redeem me;
for your word, revive me.

Salvation is far from the wicked,
for they have not sought your statutes.

Your compassions are many, Yahweh;
according to your judgments, revive me.

Many are my pursuers and my adversaries;
from your testimonies I do not turn aside.

I have seen the treacherous, and I was disgusted,
because they have not kept your word.

See that I have loved your precepts;
Yahweh, according to your covenant faithfulness, revive me.

The head of your word is truth,
and every judgment of your righteousness is forever.

verses.heading: SHIN
verses.text:
Princes pursue me without cause,
and my heart trembles from your words.

I am rejoicing over your word,
like one finding great plunder.

Falsehood I hate and I abhor;
your law I love.

Seven times in the day I praise you,
because of the judgments of your righteousness.

Great peace is to the ones loving your law,
and there is no stumbling block for them.

I hope for your salvation, Yahweh,
and I do your commandments.

My soul keeps your testimonies,
and I love them exceedingly.

I keep your precepts and your testimonies,
for all my ways are before you.

verses.heading: TAV
verses.text:
May my cry come near to your face, Yahweh;
according to your word, give me understanding.

May my plea come to your face;
according to your word, deliver me.

May my lips gush out praise,
for you teach me your statutes.

May my tongue sing of your word,
for all your commandments are righteousness.

May your hand be to help me,
for I have chosen your precepts.

I long for your salvation, Yahweh,
and your law is my delight.

May my soul live, and may it praise you,
and may your judgments help me.

I have strayed like a perishing sheep;
seek your servant, for I have not forgotten your commandments.

verses.superscription: A song of ascents.
verses.text:
To Yahweh, in the distress to me,
I called, and he answered me.

What will he give to you, and what will he add to you,
O tongue of deceit?

Arrows of a warrior, sharpened,
with coals of broom trees.

Woe to me, for I am sojourning in Meshech;
I am dwelling with the tents of Kedar.

My soul has dwelt much to itself
with a hater of peace.

I am peace, but when I speak,
they are for war.

verses.superscription: A song of ascents.
verses.text:
I lift up my eyes to the mountains.
From where does my help come?

My help is from with Yahweh,
maker of heaven and earth.

May he not give your foot to the slipping;
may your keeper not slumber.

Behold, he will not slumber,
and he will not sleep,
the keeper of Israel.

Yahweh is your keeper;
Yahweh is your shade upon your right hand.

By day the sun will not strike you,
and the moon by night.

Yahweh will keep you from all evil;
he will keep your soul.

Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in,
from now and to forever.

verses.superscription: A song of ascents; of David.
verses.text: I rejoiced in the ones saying to me, “Let us go to the house of Yahweh.”

Our feet are standing
in your gates, Jerusalem.

Jerusalem, the one built
like a city that is joined to itself together.

Where the tribes go up,
the tribes of Yah,
a testimony to Israel,
to give thanks to the name of Yahweh.

For there sit thrones for judgment,
thrones for the house of David.

Ask for the peace of Jerusalem;
may the ones loving you prosper.

Let there be peace within your rampart,
prosperity in your citadels.

For the sake of my brothers and my companions,
let me speak, please, peace in you.

For the sake of the house of Yahweh our God,
let me seek good for you.

verses.superscription: A song of ascents.
verses.text:
To you I lift up my eyes,
the one dwelling in the heavens.

Behold, as the eyes of servants are to the hand of their masters,
as the eyes of a maidservant are to the hand of her mistress,
thus our eyes are to Yahweh our God,
until he is gracious to us.

Be gracious to us, Yahweh, be gracious to us,
for we are greatly satiated with contempt.

Greatly our soul is
satiated with it, the scorn of the arrogant,
the contempt of the proud.

verses.superscription: A song of ascents; of David.
verses.text:
If not Yahweh who was for us—
let Israel indeed say—

if not Yahweh who was for us
when man rose up against us,

then they would have swallowed us alive
when their nose burned against us.

Then the waters would have overflowed us;
the torrent would have passed over our soul.
Then the raging waters would have passed over our soul.

Blessed be Yahweh,
who did not make us prey for their teeth.

Our soul is like a bird that escaped from the snare of the trappers;
the snare was broken, and we, we escaped.

Our help is in the name of Yahweh,
the maker of heaven and earth.

verses.superscription: A song of ascents.
verses.text:
Those trusting in Yahweh are like Mount Zion;
it will not be shaken; forever it abides.

Jerusalem—mountains are around her,
and Yahweh is around his people,
from now and to forever.

For the rod of wickedness will not rest on the lot of the righteous,
so that the righteous will not stretch out their hands in unrighteousness.

Do good, Yahweh, to the good,
and to the upright in their hearts.

And those twisting their crooked ways,
Yahweh will make them go with the workers of iniquity.
Peace be upon Israel.

verses.superscription: A song of ascents.
verses.text:
When Yahweh returned the captivity of Zion,
we were like ones dreaming.

Then our mouth was filled with laughter,
and our tongue with a shout of joy.
Then they said among the nations,
“Yahweh has made great to do with these.”

Yahweh has made great to do with us;
we are joyful.

Return, Yahweh, our captivity,
like the streams in the Negev.

The ones sowing in tears
will reap in a shout of joy.

Going, he may go and weeping,
carrying the bag of seed.
Coming, he will come in a shout of joy,
carrying his sheaves.

verses.superscription: A song of ascents; of Solomon.
verses.text:
If Yahweh does not build a house,
in vain its builders have labored on it.
If Yahweh does not watch a city,
in vain the watchman has stayed awake.

It is vain for you, the ones rising early to get up,
the ones being late to sit down,
the ones eating the bread of toils;
certainly he gives to his beloved one sleep.

Behold, the inheritance of Yahweh is sons;
a reward is the fruit of the womb.

Like arrows in the hand of a warrior,
thus are the sons of the youth.

The happinesses of the man who has filled his quiver of them!
They will not have shame
when they speak with adversaries in the gate.

verses.superscription: A song of ascents.
verses.text:
The happinesses of everyone fearing Yahweh,
the one walking in his ways.

The labor of your palms, when you eat it,
is your happiness, and good for you.

Your wife is like a fruitful vine
in the recesses of your house.
Your sons are like shoots of olive trees,
all around your table.
Behold, for thus the man fearing Yahweh will be blessed.

May Yahweh bless you from Zion,
that you may look on the good of Jerusalem
all of the days of your life,

and that you may see sons to your sons.
Peace be upon Israel!

verses.superscription: A song of ascents.
verses.text:
Abundantly they have afflicted me from my youth.
Let Israel indeed say:

Abundantly they have afflicted me from my youth;
however, they did not prevail against me.

Upon my back the plowers plowed;
they made long their furrows.

Yahweh is righteous;
he has cut the cords of the wicked.

Let them have shame and withdraw backward,
all the haters of Zion.

Let them be like grass of the rooftops,
that before one pulls it out, it dries up,

that the reaper does not fill his palm with,
and the one binding sheaves, does not fill his bosom,

and those passing by do not say, “The blessing of Yahweh be upon you;
we bless you in the name of Yahweh.”

verses.superscription: A song of ascents.
verses.text: Out of the depths I cry to you, Yahweh.

If you, Yah, would mark sins,
Lord, who could stand?

However, there is forgiveness with you,
so that you may be feared.

I wait for Yahweh; my soul waits,
and in his word I hope;

my soul for the Lord,
more than watchmen for the morning,
watchmen for the morning.

And he, he will redeem Israel
from all his sins.

verses.superscription: A song of ascents; of David.
verses.text:
Yahweh, my heart is not high and my eyes are not raised up,
and I do not walk in great and marvelous things beyond me.

Israel, hope in Yahweh
from now and until forever!

verses.superscription: A song of ascents.
verses.text:
Remember, Yahweh, for David,
all of his afflictions,

who swore to
Yahweh; vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob,

“If I go into the tent of my house,
if I go up on the bed of my couch,

if I give sleep to my eyes,
slumber to my eyelids,

until I find a place for Yahweh,
dwellings for the Mighty One of Jacob.”

Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah;
we found it in the fields of Jaar.

“Let us go to his dwellings;
let us bow down at the footstool of his feet.”

Arise, Yahweh, to your resting place,
you and the box of your strength.

Let your priests wear righteousness,
and let your faithful shout for joy.

For the sake of David your servant,
do not turn back the face of your anointed.

Yahweh swore to David,
in truth, he will not turn back from it:
“From the fruit of your body
I will set one on the throne for you.

If your sons keep my covenant
and my testimonies that I will teach them,
then also their sons, unto perpetuity,
will sit on the throne for you.”

For Yahweh has chosen Zion;
he desired it for a dwelling for himself.

“This is my resting place unto perpetuity;
here I will dwell, for I have desired it.

Blessing I will bless her provisions;
her needy I will satisfy with bread.

And her priests I will clothe with salvation,
and her faithful, shouting they will shout for joy.

There I will make a horn sprout for David;
I have arranged a lamp for my anointed one.

His enemies I will clothe with shame,
but upon him his crown will flourish.”

A song of ascents; of David
Behold, how good and how pleasant
is the dwelling of brothers, yes, together!

Like the good oil on the head,
coming down on the beard, the beard of Aaron,
that is coming down on the mouth of his garments,

like the dew of Hermon
that is coming down on the mountains of Zion,
for there Yahweh commanded the blessing,
life to forever.

A song of the ascents.
Behold, bless Yahweh,
all servants of Yahweh,
the ones standing in the house of Yahweh in the nights.

Lift up your hands to the holiness,
and bless Yahweh.

May Yahweh bless you from Zion,
the maker of heaven and earth.

who are standing in the house of Yahweh,
in the courts of the house of our God.

Hallelu Yah, for Yahweh is good;
make music to his name, for it is pleasant.

For Yah chose Jacob for himself;
Israel for his special possession.

For I, I know that Yahweh is great,
and our Lord than all gods.

Everything that Yahweh desires, he does,
in the heavens and on the earth,
in the seas and all deeps—

bringing up clouds from the end of the earth,
he makes lightning bolts for the rain—
bringing out wind from his storehouses,

who struck the firstborn of Egypt,
from man to beast.

He sent signs and wonders
into your midst, Egypt,
against Pharaoh and against all of his servants,

who struck many nations
and slew mighty kings:

Sihon, king of the Amorite,
and Og, king of the Bashan,
and all the kingdoms of Canaan.

And he gave their land as an inheritance,
an inheritance for Israel, his people.

Yahweh, your name is to forever;
Yahweh, your remembrance is to generation and generation.

For Yahweh vindicates his people,
and he has compassion on his servants.

The idols of the nations are silver and gold,
the work of the hands of man.

A mouth is to them, but they do not speak;
eyes are to them, but they do not see.

Ears are to them, but they do not listen;
indeed there is no breath in their mouths.

Their makers are like them—
everyone who is trusting in them.

House of Israel, bless Yahweh;
house of Aaron, bless Yahweh.

House of the Levite, bless Yahweh;
fearers of Yahweh, bless Yahweh!

Blessed be Yahweh from Zion,
the one dwelling in Jerusalem.
Hallelu Yah!

Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good,
for his covenant faithfulness is to forever.

Give thanks to the God of the gods,
for his covenant faithfulness is to forever.

Give thanks to the Lord of the lords,
for his covenant faithfulness is to forever.

To the doer of great wonders, him alone,
for his covenant faithfulness is to forever.

To the maker of the heavens by understanding,
for his covenant faithfulness is to forever.

To the one spreading out the earth over the waters,
for his covenant faithfulness is to forever.

To the maker of great lights,
for his covenant faithfulness is to forever,

the sun for dominion in the day,
for his covenant faithfulness is to forever,

the moon and stars for dominion in the night,
for his covenant faithfulness is to forever.

To the striker of Egypt in their firstborn,
for his covenant faithfulness is to forever.

And he brought out Israel from their midst,
for his covenant faithfulness is to forever.

By a strong hand and by an outstretched arm,
for his covenant faithfulness is to forever.

To the parter of the Sea of Reeds into parts,
for his covenant faithfulness is to forever.

And he made Israel pass through the midst of it,
for his covenant faithfulness is to forever.

And he tossed Pharaoh and his army into the Sea of Reeds,
for his covenant faithfulness is to forever.

To the one leading his people in the wilderness,
for his covenant faithfulness is to forever.

To the one striking great kings,
for his covenant faithfulness is to forever.

And he killed mighty kings,
for his covenant faithfulness is to forever,

Sihon, king of the Amorite,
for his covenant faithfulness is to forever,

and Og, king of the Bashan,
for his covenant faithfulness is to forever.

And he gave their land as an inheritance,
for his covenant faithfulness is to forever,

an inheritance to Israel his servant,
for his covenant faithfulness is to forever,

who, in our humiliation, remembered us,
for his covenant faithfulness is to forever.

And he tore us away from our adversaries,
for his covenant faithfulness is to forever,

giving bread to all of flesh,
for his covenant faithfulness is to forever.

Give thanks to the God of the heavens,
for his covenant faithfulness is to forever!

By the rivers of Babylon,
there we sat down, also we wept,
when we remembered Zion.

On the willows in her midst
we hung our harps.

For there our captors requested of us
words of a song,
and our tormentors, joy: “Sing for us from a song of Zion.”

How shall we sing the song of Yahweh
on the land of foreignness?

If I forget you, Jerusalem,
let my right hand forget.

Let my tongue cling to my palate
if I do not remember you, if I do not cause Jerusalem to go up
above the head of my joy.

Remember, Yahweh, for the sons of Edom,
the day of Jerusalem,
the ones saying, “Lay bare, lay bare,
to the foundation in her!”

Daughter Babylon, the devastated one,
the happinesses of the one who makes complete to you
your repayment that you paid to us!

The happinesses of the one who seizes
and dashes your infants
against the rock!

verses.superscription: Of David
verses.text:
I will thank you with my whole heart;
before the gods I will make music to you.

I will bow down toward the temple of your holiness,
and I will praise your name for your covenant faithfulness and for your trustworthiness,
for you have exalted above all of your name your word.

On the day that I called and you answered me,
you emboldened my soul with power.

May all the kings of the earth thank you, Yahweh,
because they heard the words from your mouth.

May they sing of the ways of Yahweh,
for great is the glory of Yahweh.

Though Yahweh is high, yet he sees the lowly,
and the proud he knows from far off.

verses.superscription: For the chief musician; of David; a psalm.
verses.text:
Yahweh, you have searched me
and you know me.

You, you know my sitting down and my rising up;
you understand my thought from far away.

My path and my lying down you have winnowed,
and you are familiar with all of my ways.

For there is not a word on my tongue;
behold, Yahweh, you know all of it.

Behind and before you have enclosed me,
and you have set your palm upon me.

Such knowledge is too wonderful for me;
it is high; I am not capable of it.

Where shall I go from your spirit?
And where shall I flee from your face?

If I ascend to the heavens, you are there,
and I spread out in Sheol, behold, you!

If I lift up the wings of the dawn,
dwell in the farthest part of the sea,

even there your hand will lead me,
and your right hand will hold me.

And I said, “Surely darkness will crush me,
and night, the light around me.”

For you, you created my kidneys;
you knit me together in the womb of my mother.

I will thank you because fearsomely,
I am wonderfully made.
Wonderful are your works,
and my soul knows it very well.

My frame was not hidden from you
when I was made in the secret place, when I was woven in the depths of the earth,

your eyes saw my unformed substance.
And in your book all of them were written:
the days were formed,
and yet not one of them was.

And to me, how precious are your thoughts, God!
How numerous are their heads!

If I should count them, they are more than the sand.
I awake, and I am still with you.

If only you would kill the wicked, God!
And men of bloodshed, depart from me,

who speak of you for an evil purpose;
they lift up your name to emptiness—your enemies.

Do I not hate the ones hating you, Yahweh?
And do I not loathe the ones rising up against you?

With a completeness of hatred I hate them;
they have become enemies to me.

Search me, God, and know my heart;
examine me and know my cares.

And see if a way of hurtfulness is in me,
and lead me in the way of eternity.

verses.superscription: For the chief musician; a psalm of David.
verses.text:
Rescue me, Yahweh, from an evil man;
from a man of violence preserve me,

who plot evil things in the heart;
all the day they travel around to battles.

They have sharpened their tongue like a serpent;
venom of a viper is under their lips. Selah

I have said to Yahweh, “You are my God.”
Give ear, Yahweh, to the voice of my supplications.

Yahweh, Lord, the strength of my salvation,
you have covered my head in the day of weaponry.

Do not grant, Yahweh, the desires of the wicked;
do not bring forth his plot, lest they rise up. Selah

The head of the ones surrounding me—
let the mischief of their lips cover them.

Let not a man of tongue be established in the land;
a man of violence—let evil hunt him with blows.

I know that Yahweh will do the cause of the poor,
the justice of the needy.

Surely the righteous will praise your name;
the upright will dwell before your face.

verses.superscription: A psalm of David
verses.text:
Yahweh, I cry out to you, “Hurry to me!
Give ear to my voice when I cry out to you.”

May my prayer be established like incense to your face,
a raising of my palms like the evening sacrifice.

Yahweh, place a guard over my mouth;
guard the door of my lips.

Do not turn my heart toward an evil thing
to wantonly act in activities in wickedness
with men, doers of evil.
And may I not dine on their delicacies.

Let the righteous hit me—covenant faithfulness, and he is correcting me!
Oil for the head may my head not refuse.
For my prayer is continually against their wickedness.

Their judges are thrown down beside a cliff;
and they hear my words, that they are pleasant.

“Just as splitting and breaking up in the ground,
our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.”

Yet my eyes are on you, Yahweh, Lord;
in you I take refuge; do not uncover my soul.

Keep me from the hands of the snare they have laid for me,
and the traps of the workers of evil.

Let the wicked fall into his nets together,
I, while I cross over.

verses.superscription: A maskil of David; when he was in the cave; a prayer.
verses.text:
My voice to Yahweh—I cry out;
my voice to Yahweh—I plead for favor.

I pour out my lament to his face;
my distress to his face I declare.

When my spirit faints within me,
then you, you know my path.
Along this path I walk
they have hidden a trap for me.

Look right and see
and there is no one who recognizes me.
A refuge has become lost from me;
there is no one caring for my soul.

Listen to my cry,
for I am very low;
rescue me from my pursuers,
for they are stronger than I.

Bring out my soul from prison
to praise your name.
The righteous will gather around me
because you will fulfill for me.

verses.superscription: A psalm of David
verses.text:
Hear my prayer, Yahweh; listen to my pleas!
On account of your faithfulness answer me in your righteousness!

And do not enter into judgment with your servant,
for everyone living is not righteous to your face.

So my spirit faints within me;
my heart despairs inside me.

I spread out my hands to you;
my soul, as a thirsty land, to you. Selah

Hurry! Answer me, Yahweh; my spirit is expiring!
Do not hide your face from me,
or I will become equal with those going down to the pit.

Let me hear your covenant faithfulness in the morning,
for I trust in you.
Make known to me this way I should walk,
for I lift up my soul to you.

Rescue me from my enemies, Yahweh;
I hide in you.

Teach me to do your will,
for you are my God.
May your good Spirit
lead me in a level land.

Yahweh, for the sake of your name, may you preserve my life;
in your righteousness may you bring my soul out of distress.

And in your covenant faithfulness may you destroy my enemies
and exterminate all the adversaries of my soul,
for I am your servant.

verses.superscription: Of David.
verses.text:
Blessed be Yahweh, my rock,
the one teaching my hands for war,
my fingers for battle,

my covenant faithfulness and my fortress,
my stronghold and the one rescuing me,
my shield, and in whom I take refuge,
the one subduing my people under me.

Yahweh, what is man, that you know him,
the son of man, that you consider him?

Man compares to vapor;
his days are like a passing shadow.

Yahweh, bow your heavens and come down;
touch the mountains, that they may smoke.

Light lightning and scatter them;
send your arrows and rout them.

who, their mouth speaks worthlessness,
and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

God, I will sing a new song to you;
with a lyre of ten strings I will make music to you,

the one giving salvation to kings,
the one breaking free David his servant
from the evil sword.

Break me free and deliver me
from the hand of the sons of a foreigner,
who, their mouth speaks worthlessness,
and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood,

that our sons may be like plants
having been enlarged in their youth,
our daughters, like corner pillars
carved in the pattern of a palace.

May our granaries be full,
furnishing from kind to kind;
may our flocks be thousanding,
may they be myriading in our fields.

The happinesses of the people for whom it is thus to it!
The happinesses of the people for whom Yahweh is its God!

verses.superscription: A psalm of David.
verses.text:
I will exalt you, my God, the King,
and I will bless your name forever and ever.

I will bless you every day,
and I will praise your name forever and ever.

Yahweh is great and being much praised,
and there is no searching of his greatness.

Generation to generation will proclaim your works,
and they will declare your mighty acts.

On the splendor of the glory of your majesty
and on the deeds of your making wonderful, let me meditate.

And they will tell the strength of your making fearful,
and let me recount it, your greatness.

They will pour forth the remembrance of the abundance of your goodness,
and they will sing joyfully about your righteousness.

Yahweh is gracious and compassionate,
long of nostrils and great of covenant faithfulness.

Yahweh is good to all,
and his compassions are over all of his works.

All your works will thank you, Yahweh,
and your faithful will bless you.

They will tell the glory of your kingdom,
and they will speak of your power,

to make known to the sons of man his mighty acts
and the glory of the splendor of his kingdom.

Your kingdom is a kingdom of all of eternities,
and your dominion is in every generation and generation.

Yahweh is supporting all of the ones falling
and raising up all of the ones being bowed down.

The eyes of all wait for you,
and you, you are giving their food to them in its time,

opening your hand
and satisfying every living thing with respect to desire.

Yahweh is righteous in all of his ways
and faithful in all of his works.

Yahweh is near to all of the ones calling on him,
to all who call on him in truth.

He does the desire of the ones fearing him,
and he hears their cry, and he saves them.

Yahweh is keeping all of the ones loving him,
but he destroys all of the wicked.

My mouth will speak the praise of Yahweh,
and all flesh will bless the name of his holiness forever and ever.

Hallelu Yah!
Praise Yahweh, my soul!

Let me praise Yahweh in my life;
let me make music to my God while I yet am.

Do not trust in nobles,
in the son of man, in whom there is no salvation.

His breath goes out, he returns to his ground;
on that day, his thoughts perish.

The happinesses of the one who has the God of Jacob for his help;
his hope is in Yahweh his God,

the one having made the heavens and the earth,
the sea and all that is in them,
the one keeping faithfulness forever,

doing justice for the oppressed,
giving bread to the hungry.
Yahweh is releasing the bound ones.

Hallelu Yah!
For it is good to make music to our God,
for praise is pleasant and suitable.

Yahweh builds up Jerusalem;
he gathers the scattered of Israel,

healing the broken of heart
and binding up their wounds;

counting the number of the stars,
he calls names to all of them.

Great is our Lord, and abundant of power,
his understanding is without number.

Yahweh is lifting up the poor,
bringing down the wicked to the ground.

Sing to Yahweh with thanksgiving;
make music to our God with the harp,

He gives its food to the beast,
to the sons of the raven when they call.

He does not delight in the strength of a horse;
he does not take pleasure in the legs of a man.

Yahweh takes pleasure in the ones fearing him,
the ones hoping for his covenant faithfulness.

Extol Yahweh, Jerusalem;
praise your God, Zion.

For he strengthens the bars of your gates;
he blesses your sons in your midst.

The one putting peace at your borders,
he satisfies you with the fat of wheat.

The one sending his command to the earth,
his word runs to swiftness.

The one making snow like wool,
he scatters frost like ashes.

The one sending his hail like crumbs,
who can stand to the face of his cold?

He sends his word, and he makes them melt;
he makes his wind blow, and the waters flow.

He declared his word to Jacob,
his statutes and his judgments to Israel.

He has not done this for any other nation,
and his judgments, they do not know them.
Hallelu Yah!

Praise him, all of his angels;
praise him, all of his armies.

Praise him, sun and moon;
praise him, all of the stars of light.

Praise him, heavens of the heavens,
and the waters that are above the heavens.

Let them praise the name of Yahweh,
for he, he commanded, and they were created.

And he established them forever and ever;
he gave a decree, and it will not pass away.

Praise Yahweh from the earth,
sea creatures and all depths,

fire and hail, snow and vapor,
wind of tempest, doing his word,

mountains and all hills,
tree of fruit and all cedars,

the living creature and every beast,
the creeper and the bird of wing,

kings of the earth and all peoples,
princes and all judges of the earth,

young men and also young women,
old men with youths.

And he has raised up a horn for his people,
praise for all of his faithful,
for the sons of Israel, a people near to him.
Hallelu Yah!

Hallelu Yah!
Sing to Yahweh a new song,
his praise in the assembly of the faithful.

Let Israel rejoice in his Maker;
let the sons of Zion be glad in their king.

Let them praise his name in the dance;
let them make music to him with the tambourine and the harp.

For Yahweh is taking pleasure in his people;
he beautifies the humble with salvation.

Let the faithful exult in glory;
let them sing joyfully on their beds.

Let the exaltations of God be in their throat,
and a sword of mouths in their hand,

to execute vengeance on the nations,
punishments on the peoples,

to bind their kings with chains
and their nobles with shackles of iron,

to execute on them the judgment written.
It is honor to all of his faithful.
Hallelu Yah!

Praise him for his mighty deeds;
praise him according to the abundance of his greatness.

Praise him with the blast of a shofar;
praise him with the lyre and the harp.

Praise him with the tambourine and the dance;
praise him with stringed instruments and the flute.

Praise him with cymbals of hearing;
praise him with cymbals of a shout.

Let all of the breath praise Yah!
Hallelu Yah!
